definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + carnitine = (R)-O-acetylcarnitine + CoA.

name: interleukin-18 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-18.

name: bis(monoacylglycero)phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 3-acyl-sn-glycero-1-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) = 3-acyl-sn-glycero-1-phospho-(3'-acyl-1'-sn-glycerol) + sn-glycero-1-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol).

name: citrate-L-glutamate ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + citrate + L-glutamate = ADP + phosphate + beta-citryl-L-glutamate.

name: HLA-A specific inhibitory MHC class I receptor activity
definition: Combining with a MHC class I molecule of the HLA-A subclass to mediate signaling that inhibits activation of a lymphocyte.

name: melatonin binding
definition: Binding to melatonin.

name: phosphatidylethanolamine-sterol O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a phosphatidylethanolamine + a sterol = a sterol ester + a lysophosphatidylethanolamine.

name: 2,6-dioxo-6-phenylhexa-3-enoate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,6-dioxo-6-phenylhexa-3-enoate + H2O = 2-oxopent-4-enoate + benzoate + H+.

name: light-driven active monoatomic ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Active transport of an ion across a membrane, driven by light.

name: nucleoside:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: nucleoside(out) + H+(out) = nucleoside(in) + H+(in).

name: ketohexokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-fructose = ADP + D-fructose 1-phosphate.

name: mannose-ethanolamine phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of ethanolamine phosphate to a mannose residue in the GPI lipid precursor.

name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat S5 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat (consensus YSPTSPS) = ADP + H+ + RNA polymerase II large subunit phosphoserine (position 5).

name: lysophosphatidylcholine flippase activity
definition: Catalysis of the movement of lysophosphatidylcholine from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP.

name: (+)-alpha-barbatene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate = (+)-alpha-barbatene + diphosphate.

name: 23S rRNA (adenine(2030)-N(6))-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + adenine(2030) in 23S rRNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + rRNA containing N(6)-methyladenine(2030) in 23S rRNA.

name: hemi-methylated DNA-binding
definition: Binding to double-stranded hemi-methylated DNA at replication foci (one strand methylated, while the other strand is unmethylated). Methylation of cytosine or adenine in DNA is an important mechanism for establishing stable heritable epigenetic marks.

name: N-acetyllactosaminide alpha-2,3-sialyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a beta-D-galactosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = an N-acetyl-alpha-neuraminyl-(2->3)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + CMP + H+.

name: histone H3K79 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone H3 L-lysine (position 79) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + histone H3 N6-methyl-L-lysine (position 79). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the lysine residue at position 79 of the histone H3 protein.

name: protein-N-terminal glutamine amidohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-terminal L-glutaminyl-[protein] + H2O = N-terminal L-glutamyl-[protein] + NH4+. This reaction is the deamidation of an N-terminal glutamine residue of a protein.

name: complement binding
definition: Binding to a component or product of the complement cascade.

name: alpha-2 macroglobulin receptor activity
definition: Combining with alpha-2 macroglobulin and delivering alpha-2 macroglobulin into the cell via receptor-mediated endocytosis.

name: tDNA binding
definition: Binding to DNA sequences encoding transfer RNA.

name: agmatine aminopropyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: agmatine + S-adenosyl 3-(methylsulfanyl)propylamine = H+ + N1-(3-aminopropyl)agmatine + S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine.

name: beta-carotene 15,15'-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-beta-carotene + O2 = 2 all-trans-retinal.

name: costunolide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: germacra-1(10),4,11(13)-trien-12-oate + O2 + NADPH + 2 H+ = costunolide + 2 H2O + NADP.

name: ice binding
definition: Binding to ice, water reduced to the solid state by cold temperature. It is a white or transparent colorless substance, crystalline, brittle, and viscoidal.

name: GC-box binding
definition: Binding to a GC-box, a DNA motif with the consensus sequence GGGCGG that is located upstream of the start point of eukaryotic transcription units. The GC-box may occur in multiple copies or in either orientation relative to the transcription start site.

name: ADP-D-ribose modification-dependent protein binding
definition: Binding to a protein upon ADP-ribosylation of the target protein.

name: alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminide alpha-2,6-sialyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CMP-N-acetylneuraminate + glycano-(1->3)-(N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosaminyl)-glycoprotein = CMP + glycano-[(2->6)-alpha-N-acetylneuraminyl]-(N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl)-glycoprotein.

name: Ala-tRNA(Pro) deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of misacylated Ala-tRNA(Pro).

name: troponin T binding
definition: Binding to troponin T, the tropomyosin-binding subunit of the troponin complex.

name: lactose:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: lactose(out) + H+(out) = lactose(in) + H+(in).

name: histone H3T6 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H3-threonine (position 6) + ATP = histone H3-phosphothreonine (position 6) + ADP. This reaction is the addition of a phosphate group to the threonine residue at position 6 of histone H3.

name: dol-P-Man:Man(6)GlcNAc(2)-PP-Dol alpha-1,2-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alpha-D-Man-(1->2)-alpha-D-Man-(1->2)-alpha-D-Man-(1->3)-[alpha-D-Man-(1->3)-alpha-D-Man-(1->6)]-beta-D-Man-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc-diphospho-di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + a di-trans,poly-cis-dolichyl beta-D-mannosyl phosphate = an alpha-D-Man-(1->2)-alpha-D-Man-(1->2)-alpha-D-Man-(1->3)-[alpha-D-Man-(1->2)-alpha-D-Man-(1->3)-alpha-D-Man-(1->6)]-beta-D-Man-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc-diphospho-di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + a di-trans,poly-cis-dolichyl phosphate + H+.

name: serpin family protein binding
definition: Binding to a member of the serpin protein family (serine protease inhibitors or classified inhibitor family I4). Serpins are a broadly distributed family of protease inhibitors that use a conformational change to inhibit target enzymes. They are central in controlling many important proteolytic cascades. The majority of serpins inhibit serine proteases, but serpins that inhibit caspases and papain-like cysteine proteases have also been identified. Rarely, serpins perform a non-inhibitory function; for example, several human serpins function as hormone transporters and certain serpins function as molecular chaperones or tumor suppressors.

name: heme B transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of heme B from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: alpha-adrenergic receptor activity
definition: Combining with epinephrine or norepinephrine to initiate a change in cell activity via activation of a G protein, with pharmacological characteristics of alpha-adrenergic receptors.

name: butyrate-acetoacetate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetoacetate + butanoyl-CoA = acetoacetyl-CoA + butanoate.

name: vasoactive intestinal polypeptide receptor binding
definition: Binding to a vasoactive intestinal polypeptide receptor.

name: steryl-sulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-beta-hydroxyandrost-5-en-17-one 3-sulfate + H2O = 3-beta-hydroxyandrost-5-en-17-one + sulfate.

name: oxamate carbamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carbamoyl phosphate + oxamate = oxalurate + phosphate.

name: L-threonine 3-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-threonine + NAD+ = (2S)-2-amino-3-oxobutanoate + NADH + H+.

name: cysteine dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteine + O2 = 3-sulfino-L-alanine + H+.

name: titin Z domain binding
definition: Binding to a titin Z protein domain, which recognizes and binds to the C-terminal calmodulin-like domain of alpha-actinin-2 (Act-EF34), adopts a helical structure, and binds in a groove formed by the two planes between the helix pairs of Act-EF34.

name: carcinine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of carcinine from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: choriogonadotropin hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with the choriogonadotropin hormone to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: kolavenyl diphosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-geranylgeranyl diphosphate = (+)-kolavenyl diphosphate.

name: adenosylhomocysteine nucleosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H2O = adenine + S-D-ribosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: chloride:bicarbonate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: chloride(in) + HCO3-(out) = chloride(out) + HCO3-(in).

name: BRE binding
definition: Binding to a BRE RNA element (Bruno response element).

name: 1,2-beta-fructan 1F-fructosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [(1->2)-beta-D-fructosyl](n) + [(1->2)-beta-D-fructosyl](m) = [(1->2)-beta-D-fructosyl](n+1) + [(1->2)-beta-D-fructosyl](m-1).

name: lysophosphatidic acid phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: lysophosphatidic acid + H2O = phosphate + monoacylglycerol.

name: arabinan endo-1,5-alpha-L-arabinosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->5)-alpha-arabinofuranosidic linkages in (1->5) arabinans.

name: RS domain binding
definition: Binding to an RS domain of a protein; RS domains are usually highly phosphorylated and characterized by the presence of arginine (R)/serine (S) dipeptides. The RS domain promotes protein-protein interactions and directs subcellular localization and, in certain situations, nucleocytoplasmic shuttling of individual SR proteins. They also play a role in splicing.

name: magnesium chelatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + Mg2+ + protoporphyrin IX = ADP + 3 H+ + Mg-protoporphyrin IX + phosphate.

name: L-phenylalanine dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine + NAD+ + H2O = 3-phenylpyruvate + NH4+ + NADH + H+.

name: oxaloacetate tautomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: oxaloacetate = <stereo>enol</stereo>-oxaloacetate.

name: peptide serotonyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutaminyl-[protein] + serotonin = 5-serotonyl-L-glutamyl-[protein] + NH4+.

name: histone serotonyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutaminyl-[histone] + serotonin = 5-serotonyl-L-glutamyl-[histone] + NH4+.

name: rhamnogalacturonan acetylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of acetylesters (as acetate) from galacturonic acid residues in the backbone of rhamnogalacturonan.

name: thyroid hormone transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of thyroid hormones from one side of a membrane to the other. Thyroid hormone are any of the compounds secreted by the thyroid gland, largely thyroxine and triiodothyronine.

name: single cytosine insertion binding
definition: Binding to a double-stranded DNA region containing a single cytosine insertion or a deletion that results in an unpaired cytosine.

name: NAD-dependent protein decrotonylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD+ = 2''-O-(2E)-but-2-enoyl-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[protein] + nicotinamide.

name: alkylmercury lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alkylmercury + H+ = an alkane + Hg2+.

name: splicing factor binding
definition: Binding to a protein involved in the process of removing sections of the primary RNA transcript to form the mature form of the RNA.

name: interleukin-23 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-23.

name: 5(S)-hydroxyperoxy-6E,8Z,11Z,14Z-icosatetraenoic acid binding
definition: Binding to 5(S)-hydroxyperoxy-6E,8Z,11Z,14Z-icosatetraenoic acid, a straight-chain fatty acid with twenty carbon atoms and four double bonds.

name: histone decrotonylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[histone] = (2E)-2-butenoate + L-lysyl-[histone].

name: protein decrotonylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] = (2E)-2-butenoate + L-lysyl-[protein].

name: histone decrotonylase activity, NAD-dependent
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[histone] + NAD+ = 2''-O-(2E)-but-2-enoyl-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[histone] + nicotinamide.

name: histone H4K20 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone H4 L-lysine (position 20) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + histone H4 N6-methyl-L-lysine (position 20). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the lysine residue at position 20 of the histone H4 protein.

name: 8-oxoguanine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + 7,8-dihydro-8-oxoguanine + H2O = 7,9-dihydro-1H-purine-2,6,8(3H)-trione + ammonium.

name: 1,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + 1,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylate = NADH + CO2 + catechol.

name: macrocin O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + macrocin = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+ + tylosin.

name: hydroxylamine reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an acceptor + NH4+ + H2O = hydroxylamine + a reduced acceptor + H+.

name: phenylcoumaran benzylic ether reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the NADPH-dependent 7-O-4' reduction of phenylcoumaran lignans to the corresponding diphenols; for example, catalysis of the reaction: dehydrodiconiferyl alcohol + NADPH + H+ = isodihydrodehydrodiconiferyl alcohol + NADP+.

name: vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 3 binding
definition: Binding to a vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 3.

name: D-aspartate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-aspartate + H2O + O2 = H2O2 + NH4+ + oxaloacetate.

name: inositol phosphorylceramide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an L-1-phosphatidyl-inositol + a dihydroceramide = an inositol phosphodihydroceramide + a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol.

name: pyruvate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + O2 + phosphate + pyruvate = acetyl phosphate + CO2 + H2O2.

name: phosphocholine transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CDP-choline + protein-serine = CMP + protein-serine-choline phosphate.

name: trihydroxypterocarpan dimethylallyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (6AS,11AS)-3,6A,9-trihydroxypterocarpan + dimethylallyl-pyrophosphate = glyceollin + diphosphate.

name: steroid 22S-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a C28-steroid + O2 + reduced NADPH--hemoprotein reductase = a (22S)-22-hydroxy C28-steroid + H+ + H2O + oxidized NADPH--hemoprotein reductase. Also catalyzes the C-22 hydroxylation of a variety of C27 and C29 steroids.

name: BIR domain binding
definition: Binding to a Baculovirus Inhibitor of apoptosis protein Repeat (BIR) domain.

name: vasopressin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a vasopressin receptor.

name: P-type calcium transporter activity involved in regulation of cardiac muscle cell membrane potential
definition: A calcium-transporting P-type ATPase activity involved in regulation of the plasma membrane potential.

name: interleukin-22 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-22.

name: palmitoyl-[glycerolipid] 7-desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-acyl-2-hexadecanoyl-glycerolipid + 2 H+ + O2 + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] = a 1-acyl-2-[(7Z)-hexadecenoyl]-glycerolipid + 2 H2O + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin].

name: malate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reversible conversion of pyruvate or oxaloacetate to malate.

name: protein-lysine lysyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-beta-lysine + L-lysyl-[protein] + ATP = N6-((3R)-3,6-diaminohexanoyl)-L-lysyl-[protein] + AMP + diphosphate + H+n. This reaction is the addition of lysine group from one protein to a lysine residue in a second protein, producing N6-(lysyl)-L-lysine.

name: calcium- and calmodulin-responsive adenylate cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP = 3',5'-cyclic AMP + diphosphate, stimulated by calcium-bound calmodulin.

name: adenylate cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP = 3',5'-cyclic AMP + diphosphate.

name: fatty-acyl-ethyl-ester synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain-acyl ethyl ester + H2O = a long-chain carboxylic acid + ethanol.

name: nucleoside-specific channel forming porin activity
definition: Enables the energy independent passage of nucleoside, sized less than 1000 Da, across a membrane. The transmembrane portions of porins consist exclusively of beta-strands which form a beta-barrel. They are found in the outer membranes of Gram-negative bacteria, mitochondria, plastids and possibly acid-fast Gram-positive bacteria.

name: acetylcholine receptor activity
definition: Combining with an acetylcholine receptor ligand and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: low-affinity basic amino acid transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of basic amino acids from one side of a membrane to the other. Basic amino acids have a pH above 7. In low-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute only if it is present at very high concentrations.

name: hyaluronate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hyaluronate(n) = n 3-(4-deoxy-beta-D-gluc-4-enuronosyl)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + H2O.

name: reticuline oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-reticuline + O2 = (S)-scoulerine + H2O2 + H+. Also acts on related compounds, converting the N-methyl group into the methylene bridge ('berberine bridge') of (S)- tetrahydroprotoberberines.

name: coniferyl-alcohol glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: coniferyl alcohol + UDP-D-glucose = coniferin + UDP.

name: CDP-ribitol ribitolphosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ribitol phosphate(n) + CDP-ribitol = ribitol phosphate(n+1) + CMP.

name: tyrosine phenol-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine + H2O = NH4 + phenol + pyruvate.

name: red or far-red light photoreceptor activity
definition: The function of absorbing and responding to electromagnetic radiation with a wavelength of approximately 660-730nm. The response may involve a change in conformation.

name: tRNA-queuosine(34) beta-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-alpha-D-mannose + queuosine34 in tRNA(Asp) = GDP + H+ + O-4''-alpha-D-mannosylqueuosine34 in tRNA(Asp).

name: [3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring)] kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-seryl-[3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate dehydrogenase] = ADP + H+ + O-phospho-L-seryl-[3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate dehydrogenase].

name: malate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of malate from one side of a membrane to the other. Malate is a chiral hydroxydicarboxylic acid, hydroxybutanedioic acid. The (+) enantiomer is an important intermediate in metabolism as a component of both the TCA cycle and the glyoxylate cycle.

name: 5-amino-1-ribofuranosylimidazole-4-carboxamide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of 5-amino-1-ribofuranosylimidazole-4-carboxamide from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: xanthophyll binding
definition: Binding to xanthophylls, any of several neutral yellow to orange carotenoid pigments containing oxygen.

name: 2-succinyl-5-enolpyruvyl-6-hydroxy-3-cyclohexene-1-carboxylic-acid synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + H+ + isochorismate = 5-enolpyruvoyl-6-hydroxy-2-succinyl-cyclohex-3-ene-1-carboxylate + CO2.

name: mannosyl-oligosaccharide 1,3-alpha-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the alpha-(1->3) bonds of alpha-D-mannose residues in mannosyl-oligosaccharide.

name: histone H2B acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H2B L-lysine = CoA + histone H2B N6-acetyl-L-lysine.

name: glucose-6-phosphate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of glucose-6-phosphate from one side of a membrane to the other. Glucose-6-phosphate is a monophosphorylated derivative of glucose with the phosphate group attached to C-6.

name: 3-phenylpropionate dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phenylpropionate + NADH + H+ + O2 = NAD+ + cis-3-(3-carboxyethyl)-3,5-cyclohexadiene-1,2-diol.

name: mRNA N6-methyladenosine dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the oxidative demethylation of N6-methyladenosine RNA, with concomitant decarboxylation of 2-oxoglutarate and releases oxidized methyl group on N6-methyladenosine as formaldehyde.

name: succinate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: succinate semialdehyde + NADP+ + H2O = succinate + NADPH + 2 H+.

name: siderophore uptake transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: siderophore-iron(ferrioxamine)(out) + H+(out) = siderophore-iron(ferrioxamine)(in) + H+(in).

name: proton binding
definition: Binding to proton.

name: mRNA cap binding complex binding
definition: Binding to a mRNA cap binding complex.

name: protein-phosphocysteine-D-fructose-phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein S-phosphocysteine + D-fructose(out) = protein cysteine + D-fructose-1-phosphate(in).

name: Se-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group to the selenium atom of an acceptor molecule.

name: protein-N-terminal-alanine acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + N-terminal L-alanyl-[protein] = CoA + H+ + N-terminal N(alpha)-acetyl-L-alanyl-[protein].

name: 3alpha-hydroxy-ent-sandaracopimardiene 9-beta-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ent-sandaracopimaradien-3-beta-ol + NADPH + H+ + O2 = oryzalexin E + NADP + H2O.

name: nicotinamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinamide + H2O = nicotinate + NH4+.

name: thyrotropin-releasing hormone receptor binding
definition: Binding to a receptor for thyrotropin-releasing hormone, a tripeptide hormone that is produced by the hypothalamus and stimulates the release of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) and prolactin by the anterior pituitary.

name: adrenomedullin binding
definition: Binding to adrenomedullin (AM).

name: peptidylamidoglycolate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: peptidylamidoglycolate = peptidyl amide + glyoxylate.

name: MRF binding
definition: Binding to Myogenic Regulatory Factor (MRF), a member of the basic Helix-Loop-Helix (bHLH) superfamily of transcription factors.

name: primary fluorescent dioxobilin-type chlorophyll catabolite methylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + primary fluorescent dioxobilin-type chlorophyll catabolite = H+ + methanol + O13(4)-desmethyl pFCC.

name: quinoprotein glucose dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose + ubiquinone = D-glucono-1,5-lactone + ubiquinol.

name: nuclear steroid receptor activity
definition: A nuclear receptor activity regulated by steroid binding and modulating the transcription of specific gene sets transcribed by RNA polymerase II.

name: nuclear glucocorticoid receptor activity
definition: A nuclear receptor activity regulated by glucocorticoid binding and modulating the transcription of specific gene sets transcribed by RNA polymerase II.

name: nuclear cortisol receptor activity
definition: A nuclear receptor activity regulated by cortisol binding and modulating the transcription of specific gene sets transcribed by RNA polymerase II.

name: inositol pentakisphosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: myo-inositol pentakisphosphate + H2O = myo-inositol tetrakisphosphate + phosphate.

name: 1-(5-phosphoribosyl)-5-[(5-phosphoribosylamino)methylideneamino]imidazole-4-carboxamide isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(5-phosphoribosyl)-5-[(5-phosphoribosylamino)methylideneamino]imidazole-4-carboxamide = 5-[(5-phospho-1-deoxy-D-ribulos-1-ylimino)methylamino]-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxamide.

name: magnesium protoporphyrin IX methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Mg-protoporphyrin IX + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = Mg-protoporphyrin IX 13-monomethyl ester + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: selenocystathionine gamma-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction:L-selenocystathionine + H2O = L-selenocysteine + 2-oxobutanoate + NH4+.

name: ornithine racemase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ornithine = D-ornithine.

name: 20-aldehyde-leukotriene B4 20-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 20-oxo-leukotriene B4 + O2 + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = 20-carboxy-leukotriene B4 + 2 H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase].

name: dihydroorotate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-dihydroorotate + A = AH(2) + orotate.

name: cyanamide hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: urea = cyanamide + H2O.

name: UDP-galactose:N-glycan beta-1,3-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + N-glycan = galactose-beta-1,3-N-glycan + UDP.

name: DNA-7-methylguanine glycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: DNA containing 7-methylguanine + H2O = DNA with abasic site + 7-methylguanine. This reaction is the hydrolysis of DNA by cleavage of the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the damaged DNA 7-methylguanine and the deoxyribose sugar to remove the 7-methylguanine, leaving an abasic site.

name: chromate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of chromate from one side of a membrane to the other. Chromate is the anion of chromic acid, H2CrO4 (aq) or CrO3.

name: quercitrin binding
definition: Binding to quercitrin.

name: chrysanthemyl diphosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 dimethylallyl diphosphate = (R,R)-chrysanthemyl diphosphate + diphosphate.

name: S-ribosylhomocysteine lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-(5-deoxy-D-ribos-5-yl)-L-homocysteine = (S)-4,5-dihydroxypentane-2,3-dione + L-homocysteine.

name: GTP diphosphokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + GTP = AMP + guanosine 3'-diphosphate 5'-triphosphate.

name: tRNA-specific adenosine-37 deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine-37 + H2O = inosine-37 + NH4+, in a tRNA-Ala molecule.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoate 3-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + NADPH + H+ + O2 = protocatechuate + NADP+ + H2O.

name: iron sensor activity
definition: Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of iron.

name: prostaglandin binding
definition: Binding to prostaglandin.

name: ionotropic salty taste receptor activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a soluble salty compound has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: mannitol 2-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannitol + NAD+ = D-fructose + NADH.

name: ATP-gated ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when ATP has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: NAD+ binding
definition: Binding to the oxidized form, NAD, of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, a coenzyme involved in many redox and biosynthetic reactions.

name: tetrahydrocolumbamine 2-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-tetrahydrocolumbamine + S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+ + tetrahydropalmatine.

name: anthocyanidin 3-O-glucoside 2''-O-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-glucose + an anthocyanidin-3-O-beta-D-glucoside = UDP + H+ + an anthocyanidin 3-O-sophoroside.

name: indole-3-acetonitrile nitrile hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: indole-3-acetonitrile + H2O = indole-3-acetamide.

name: cytosine C-5 DNA demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methyl-dCpdG DNA + H2O = dCpdG DNA + methanol. This reaction is the hydrolytic removal of the methyl group on the 5 position of cytosine in DNA.

name: saccharopine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of N6-(L-1,3-dicarboxypropyl)-L-lysine to release an amino acid (lysine or glutamate), with the concomitant reduction of an electron acceptor.

name: 1,4-alpha-glucan branching enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a segment of a (1->4)-alpha-D-glucan chain to a primary hydroxyl group in a similar glucan chain.

name: carnitine 3-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carnitine + NAD+ = 3-dehydrocarnitine + H+ + NADH.

name: calmodulin-activated 3',5'-cyclic-GMP phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: nucleoside 3',5'-cyclic GMP + H2O = GMP + H+; this activity is activated by binding to calcium-bound calmodulin.

name: 17alpha-hydroxyprogesterone binding
definition: Binding to 17alpha-hydroxyprogesterone.

name: beta-pyrazolylalanine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-acetyl-L-serine + pyrazole = 3-(pyrazol-1-yl)-L-alanine + acetate + H+.

name: AF-1 domain binding
definition: Binding to an AF-1 protein domain, a ligand-independent transactivation domain which is required for the full transcriptional activity of the receptor.

name: eukaryotic elongation factor-2 kinase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of the enzyme eukaryotic elongation factor-2 kinase.

name: type 2 orexin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 2 orexin receptor.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + 4-hydroxybenzoate + CoA = AMP + diphosphate + 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA.

name: aminodeoxychorismate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamine + chorismate = 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate + L-glutamate. It is composed of two enzymatic activities (which may be present on one or two polypeptides); the first is a glutaminase which yields ammonia from glutamine, releasing glutamate. The ammonia is used by the second activity which catalyzes the amination of chorismate to form 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate.

name: 3-hydroxy-2-methylpyridine-4,5-dicarboxylate 4-decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-hydroxy-6-methylpyridine-3,4-dicarboxylate + H+ = 5-hydroxy-6-methylpyridine-3-carboxylate + CO2.

name: 4-formylbenzenesulfonate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-formylbenzenesulfonate + H2O + NAD+ = 4-sulfobenzoate + 2 H+ + NADH.

name: U3 snoRNA binding
definition: Binding to a U3 small nucleolar RNA.

name: inositol-1,3,4,5-tetrakisphosphate 6-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 1,3,4,5-tetrakisphosphate + ATP = 1D-myo-inositol 1,3,4,5,6-pentakisphosphate + ADP + H+.

name: protein-RNA sequence-specific adaptor activity
definition: A protein adaptor activity characterized by the capacity to selectively recognize and interact with RNA molecules in a sequence-specific manner. Entities possessing this activity typically exhibit discerning binding preferences for specific nucleotide sequences within RNA molecules, enabling the identification and engagement of distinct RNA motifs or structural elements. This function is integral to various biological processes, including RNA processing, transport, and regulatory mechanisms, contributing to the specificity and precision of cellular RNA-related activities.

name: (25S)-Delta(7)-dafachronate binding
definition: Binding to (25S)-Delta(7)-dafachronate.

name: 5-methyl-phenazine-1-carboxylate N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenazine-1-carboxylate + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5-methyl-phenazine-1-carboxylate + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: mannosyl-oligosaccharide 1,3-1,6-alpha-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the terminal (1->3)- and (1->6)-linked alpha-D-mannose residues in the mannosyl-oligosaccharide Man(5)(GlcNAc)(3).

name: amygdalin beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-amygdalin + H2O = (R)-prunasin + D-glucose.

name: tetrahydrobiopterin binding
definition: Binding to a tetrahydrobiopterin, 5,6,7,8-tetrahydrobiopterin or a derivative thereof; tetrahydrobiopterins are enzyme cofactors that carry electrons in redox reactions.

name: CoA carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the joining of a carboxyl group to a molecule that is attached to CoA, with the concomitant hydrolysis of the diphosphate bond in ATP or a similar triphosphate.

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a UDP-N-acetylglucosamine from one side of a membrane to the other. N-acetylglucosamine is a substance composed of N-acetylglucosamine, a common structural unit of oligosaccharides, in glycosidic linkage with uridine diphosphate.

name: L-methionine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-methionine + 2-oxoglutarate = 4-methylsulfanyl-2-oxobutanoate + L-glutamate.

name: histone H4K12 deacetylase activity, hydrolytic mechanism
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 12) + H2O = histone H4 L-lysine (position 12) + acetate. This reaction represents the removal of an acetyl group from lysine at position 12 of the histone H4 protein.

name: mannosyl-oligosaccharide 1,6-alpha-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the alpha-(1->6) bonds of alpha-D-mannose residues in mannosyl-oligosaccharide.

name: transmitter-gated monoatomic ion channel activity involved in regulation of postsynaptic membrane potential
definition: Any transmitter-gated ion channel activity that is involved in regulation of postsynaptic membrane potential.

name: zinc:proton antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of zinc from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: H+(out) + Zn2+(in) = H+(in) + Zn2+(out).

name: indole-3-glycerol-phosphate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (1S,2R)-1-C-(indol-3-yl)glycerol 3-phosphate = indole + D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate.

name: zinc efflux transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a zinc ion or zinc ions from the inside of the cell to the outside of the cell across a membrane.

name: taurine dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + O2 + taurine = aminoacetaldehyde + CO2 + succinate + sulfite.

name: alpha-glucan, water dikinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [(1->4)-alpha-D-glucosyl](n) + n ATP + n H2O = [(1->4)-6-phospho-alpha-D-glucosyl](n) + n AMP + 2n H+ + n phosphate.

name: low-affinity sodium:dicarboxylate symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: dicarboxylate(out) + Na+(out) = dicarboxylate(in) + Na+(in). In low-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute only if it is present at very high concentrations.

name: phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate binding
definition: Binding to phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate, a derivative of phosphatidylinositol in which the inositol ring is phosphorylated at the 3', 4' and 5' positions.

name: gamma-butyrobetaine dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoate + O2 = carnitine + CO2 + succinate.

name: nicotinate-N-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinate + UDP-D-glucose = N-(beta-D-glucosyl)nicotinate + UDP.

name: myosin light chain kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + myosin-light-chain = ADP + myosin-light-chain phosphate.

name: prostanoid receptor binding
definition: Binding to a prostanoid receptor.

name: thromboxane A2 receptor binding
definition: Binding to a thromboxane A2 receptor.

name: tRNA (guanine(18)-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + guanosine 18 in tRNA= S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 2'-O-methylguanosine 18 in tRNA + H+.

name: hydroxymethylfurfural reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-hydroxymethylfurfural + NADH + H+ = 2,5-bis-hydroxymethylfuran + NAD+.

name: polyprenol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a di-trans,poly-cis-polyprenol + NAD+ = a di-trans,poly-cis-polyprenal + NADH + H+.

name: L-idonate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-idonate from one side of a membrane to the other. L-idonate is an aldonic acid derived from L-idose, an aldohexose which is epimeric with D-glucose.

name: zinc:bicarbonate symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: zinc(out) + HCO3-(out) = zinc(in) + HCO3-(in).

name: monoatomic cation:bicarbonate symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: monoatomic cation(out) + HCO3-(out) = monoatomic cation(in) + HCO3-(in).

name: Tat protein binding
definition: Binding to Tat, a viral transactivating regulatory protein from the human immunodeficiency virus, or the equivalent protein from another virus.

name: prunasin beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-prunasin + H2O = D-glucose + mandelonitrile.

name: fluorothreonine transaldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-threonine + fluoroacetaldehyde = acetaldehyde + 4-fluoro-L-threonine.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA thioesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA + H2O = 4-hydroxybenzoate + CoA + H+.

name: neurotransmitter receptor regulator activity
definition: A molecular function that directly (via physical interaction or direct modification) activates, inhibits or otherwise modulates the activity of a neurotransmitter receptor. Modulation of activity includes changes in desensitization rate, ligand affinity, ion selectivity and pore-opening/closing.

name: acetylcholine receptor regulator activity
definition: Interacting (directly or indirectly) with acetylcholine receptors such that the proportion of receptors in the active form is changed.

name: glutathione transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RX + glutathione = an S-substituted glutathione + a halide anion + H+.

name: sequence-specific DNA binding, bending
definition: The activity of binding selectively and non-covalently to DNA in a sequence-specific manner and distorting the original structure of DNA, typically a straight helix, into a bend, or increasing the bend if the original structure was intrinsically bent due to its sequence.

name: glycyl-radical enzyme activating activity
definition: Catalyzes the activation of an enzyme by generating an organic free radical on a glycine residue via a homolytic cleavage of S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM).

name: peroxisome matrix targeting signal-2 binding
definition: Binding to a type 2 peroxisome targeting signal, a nonapeptide with a broad consensus sequence of (R/K)-(L/V/I)-(XXXXX)-(H/Q)-(L/A/F).

name: citrullinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-citrulline + H2O + 2 H+ = L-ornithine + NH4+ + CO2.

name: D-alanyl carrier activity
definition: Binding a D-alanine and presenting it for processing or offloading to a cognate enzyme. Covalently binds the D-alanine via a phosphopantetheine prosthetic group and mediates protein-protein interactions with the enzyme conferring specificity. The carrier protein provides an essential link between the D-alanine-D-alanyl carrier protein ligase and the incorporation of D-alanine into lipoteichoic acid by transferring activated D-alanine to cell membrane phosphatidylglycerol (PG).

name: protein-fructosamine 3-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a [protein]-N6-D-fructosyl-L-lysine = ADP + H+ + a [protein]-N6-(3-O-phospho-D-fructosyl)-L-lysine.

name: dopamine beta-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ascorbate + dopamine + O2 = (R)-noradrenaline + dehydroascorbate + H2O.

name: beta-1,4-mannosylglycolipid beta-1,3-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of N-acetylglucosamine (GlcNAc) in a beta-1,3 linkage to the mannose(beta-1,4)Glc disaccharide core of glycolipids.

name: phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate sensor activity
definition: Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate.

name: D-ribulose-phosphate 3-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribulose 5-phosphate = D-xylulose 5-phosphate.

name: GDP-mannose hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-mannose + H2O = GMP + mannose-1-phosphate.

name: phosphoribosyl 1,2-cyclic phosphate 1,2-diphosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-ribose 1,2-cyclic phosphate 5-phosphate + H2O = D-ribose 2,5-bisphosphate + H+.

name: L-mimosine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,4-dihydroxypyridine + O-acetyl-L-serine = 3-(3,4-dihydroxypyridinium-1-yl)-L-alanine + acetate.

name: allantoicase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: allantoate + H2O = (S)-ureidoglycolate + urea.

name: apelin receptor activity
definition: Combining with the peptide apelin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: glucuronyl-galactosyl-proteoglycan 4-alpha-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-O-(beta-D-GlcA-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-beta-D-Xyl)-L-seryl-[protein] + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine = 3-O-(alpha-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcA-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-beta-D-Xyl)-L-seryl-[protein] + H+ + UDP.

name: maleylpyruvate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-maleylpyruvate(2-) + H2O = H+ + maleate(2-) + pyruvate.

name: high-affinity D-glucose transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of D-glucose from one side of a membrane to the other. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations.

name: methylamine dehydrogenase (amicyanin) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2O + methylamine + 2 oxidized [amicyanin] = formaldehyde + 2 H+ + NH4+ + 2 reduced [amicyanin].

name: acyl-CoA (9+3)-desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the introduction of a cis double bond at position 12 of fatty-acyl-CoAs that contain a cis double bond at position 9. Specific reactions include: (9Z)-hexadecenoyl-CoA + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = (9Z,12Z)-hexadecadienoyl-CoA + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O; and (9Z)-hexadecenoyl-CoA + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + O2 + 2 H(+) = (9Z,12Z)-hexadecadienoyl-CoA + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O.

name: valine N-monooxygenase (oxime forming) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-valine + 2 O2 + 2 NADPH(4-) + 2 H+ = (E)-2-methylpropanal oxime + 2 NADP(3-) + carbon dioxide + 3 H2O.

name: histone H2A acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H2A L-lysine = CoA + histone H2A N6-acetyl-L-lysine.

name: thalianol synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cyclization of 3(S)-oxidosqualene to (3S,13S,14R)-malabarica-8,17,21-trien-3-ol (thalianol).

name: cytokinin 9-beta-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-alkylaminopurine + UDP-D-glucose = 6-alkylamino-9-beta-D-glucosylpurine + H+ + UDP. This reaction is an N-glucosylation event.

name: myosin heavy chain kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + myosin-heavy-chain = ADP + myosin-heavy-chain phosphate.

name: L-arabinokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arabinose + ATP = beta-L-arabinose 1-phosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: ATP-dependent histone chaperone activity
definition: Binding to and carrying a histone or a histone complex to unload or deposit it as a nucleosome, driven by ATP hydrolysis.

name: cyclohexadienyl dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arogenate + NAD+ = L-tyrosine + NADH + CO2.

name: methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-methyltetrahydrofolate + NAD(P)+ = 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoate geranyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: geranyl diphosphate + 4-hydroxybenzoic acid = 3-geranyl-4-hydroxybenzoate + diphosphoric acid.

name: Viteagnusin D synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + peregrinol diphosphate = diphosphate + viteagnusin D.

name: tRNA (guanine(27)-N2)-dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(27) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N(2)-dimethylguanosine(27) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: D-serine ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-serine = pyruvate + NH4+.

name: glutamyl aminopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the release of a N-terminal glutamate (and to a lesser extent aspartate) from a peptide.

name: 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an 11-beta-hydroxysteroid + NAD+ = an 11-oxosteroid + NADH + H+.

name: histone H1-4S35 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H1-4-serine (position 35) + ATP = histone H1-4-phosphoserine (position 35) + ADP.

name: endoplasmic reticulum-plasma membrane adaptor activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a plasma membrane with an endoplasmic reticulum membrane, via membrane lipid binding, to establish membrane contact sites and mediate exchange and communication.

name: L-ascorbate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 L-ascorbate + O2 = 4 monodehydroascorbate + 2 H2O.

name: zinc ion sequestering activity
definition: Binding to a zinc ion to prevent it from interacting with other partners or to inhibit its localization to the area of the cell or complex where it is active.

name: lupeol synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2,3-epoxysqualene = lupeol. This reaction is the cyclization of (S)-2,3-epoxysqualene (2,3-oxidosqualene) to lupeol.

name: long-chain fatty acyl-CoA hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain fatty acyl-CoA + H2O = a long-chain fatty acid + CoA + H+. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons.

name: 3-cyanoalanine hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-asparagine = 3-cyano-L-alanine + H2O + H+.

name: alcohol O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + an alcohol = CoA + an acetyl ester.

name: xanthan lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: xanthan = oligosaccharide with 4-deoxy-alpha-L-threo-hex-4-enuronosyl end + pyruvylate mannose. This reaction is the eliminative cleavage of the terminal beta-D-mannosyl-beta-D-1,4-glucuronosyl linkage of the side-chain of the polysaccharide xanthan, leaving a 4-deoxy-alpha-L-threo-hex-4-enuronosyl group at the terminus of the side-chain.

name: pinene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: geranyl diphosphate = pinene + diphosphate. This reaction can produce (1R,5R)-alpha-pinene, (1S,5S)-alpha-pinene, (1R,5R)-beta-pinene and (1S,5S)-beta-pinene.

name: leukotriene-A4 hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + leukotriene A(4) = leukotriene B(4).

name: uroporphyrinogen-III synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydroxymethylbilane = H2O + uroporphyrinogen III.

name: bis(5'-adenosyl)-hexaphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: P1-P6-bis(5'-adenosyl) hexaphosphate + H2O = AMP + adenosine 5'-pentaphosphate.

name: carbon monoxide sensor activity
definition: Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of carbon monoxide (CO).

name: strictosidine beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3alpha(S)-strictosidine + H2O = D-glucose + strictosidine aglycone.

name: ionotropic glutamate receptor binding
definition: Binding to an ionotropic glutamate receptor. Ionotropic glutamate receptors bind glutamate and exert an effect through the regulation of ion channels.

name: sphingolipid 8-(E/Z)-desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-acyl-(4R)-4-hydroxysphinganine + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = a (4R,8E)-4-hydroxysphingenine ceramide + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O or an N-acyl-(4R)-4-hydroxysphinganine + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = (4R,8Z)-4-hydroxysphing-8-enine ceramide + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O. This results in the formation of a double bond between C8 and C9 of the long chain base of a sphingolipid.

name: peptide YY receptor activity
definition: Combining with gut peptide YY to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: ABC-type capsular-polysaccharide transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + capsular polysaccharide(in) = ADP + phosphate + capsular polysaccharide(out).

name: baruol synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2,3-epoxysqualene = baruol. Baruol is also known as D:B-Friedo-Baccharan-5,21-dien-3-ol.

name: dATP binding
definition: Binding to dATP, deoxyadenosine triphosphate.

name: monocoumaroyl dicaffeoyl spermidine meta-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: monocoumaroyl dicaffeoyl spermidine + NADPH + O2 = tricaffeoyl spermidine + NADP+ + H2O.

name: 2-hydroxyphytanoyl-CoA lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxyphytanoyl-CoA = 2,6,10,14-tetramethylpentadecanal + formyl-CoA.

name: beta-endorphin binding
definition: Binding to beta-endorphin, a peptide generated by the cleavage of pro-opiomelanocortin.

name: D-tyrosyl-tRNA(Tyr) deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-tyrosyl-tRNATyr + H2O = D-tyrosine + tRNATyr. Removal of a D-tyrosine from a charged tRNA(Tyr).

name: 6-phospho-beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-phospho-beta-D-glucoside-(1,4)-D-glucose + H2O = D-glucose 6-phosphate + glucose.

name: butanol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: butan-1-ol + NAD+ = butanal + H+ + NADH.

name: maleate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: maleate = fumarate.

name: arsenite methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + arsenite = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + methylarsonate.

name: mitochondrial ATP-gated potassium channel activity
definition: Enables the ATP-dependent diffusion of a potassium ion across the mitochondrial inner membrane.

name: 5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: FMNH2 + O2 = 5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole + D-erythrose 4-phosphate + dialuric acid.

name: tetrahydrofolyl-poly(glutamate) polymer binding
definition: Binding to tetrahydrofolyl-poly(glutamate) polymer.

name: methyl farnesoate epoxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methyl (2E,6E)-farnesoate + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = H+ + H2O + juvenile hormone III + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: U12 snRNA binding
definition: Binding to a U12 small nuclear RNA (U12 snRNA).

name: cystathionine gamma-synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteine + O-succinyl-L-homoserine = H+ + L,L-cystathionine + succinate.

name: calcidiol 1-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: calcidiol + H+ + NADPH + O2 = calcitriol + H2O + NADP+.

name: transferrin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a transferrin receptor.

name: G protein-coupled nucleotide receptor binding
definition: Binding to a G protein-coupled (metabotropic) nucleotide receptor.

name: L-xylulose reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: xylitol + NAD+ = L-xylulose + NADH + H+.

name: pectinesterase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of pectinesterase.

name: minus-end-directed microtubule motor activity
definition: A motor activity that generates movement along a microtubule toward the minus end, driven by ATP hydrolysis.

name: phosphatidylinositol lysophospholipase A1 activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol) + H2O = sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol + a fatty acid + H+.

name: L-phenylalanine N-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine + 2 NADPH + 2 O2 + 2 H+ = (E)-phenylacetaldehyde oxime + 2 NADP + 3 H2O + carbon dioxide.

name: D-galactonate:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-galactonate(out) + H+(out) = D-galactonate(in) + H+(in).

name: tRNA (guanine(26)-N2)-dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction:guanosine(26) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N(2)-dimethylguanosine(26) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: oxytocin receptor activity
definition: Combining with oxytocin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: pre-mRNA 5'-splice site binding
definition: Binding to a pre-mRNA 5' splice site sequence.

name: para-aminobenzoyl-glutamate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: para-aminobenzoyl-glutamate + H2O = para-aminobenzoate + L-glutamate.

name: 3,8-divinyl protochlorophyllide a 8-vinyl-reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protochlorophyllide a + NADP+ = 3,8-divinyl protochlorophyllide a + NADPH + H+, and chlorophyllide a + NADP+ = 3,8-divinyl chlorophyllide a + NADPH + H+.

name: L-aspartate:prephenate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arogenate + oxaloacetate = prephenate + L-aspartate.

name: high-affinity L-ornithine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-ornithine from one side of a membrane to the other. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations.

name: ABC-type bacteriocin transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a bacteriocin from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate.

name: ABC-type xenobiotic transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + xenobiotic(in) = ADP + phosphate + xenobiotic(out).

name: prolactin receptor activity
definition: Combining with prolactin and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: ascr#2 binding
definition: Binding to ascr#2.

name: farnesoic acid O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesoate + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = methyl (2E,6E)-farnesoate + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. Also converts juvenile hormone III carboxylate into juvenile hormone-III.

name: hydroperoxy icosatetraenoate isomerase activity
definition: A hydroperoxy icosatetraenoate = a hydroxy epoxy icosatrienoate.

name: rosmarinate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: caffeoyl-CoA + 3-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)lactate = CoA + rosmarinate.

name: 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoyl-CoA thioesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoyl-CoA + H2O = 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoate + CoA + H+.

name: cobalt-precorrin-7 C15-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cobalt-precorrin 7 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = cobalt-precorrin 8 + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + CO2.

name: mannosylglycerate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R)-2-O-(alpha-D-mannosyl)-glycerate + H2O = (R)-glycerate + D-mannose.

name: L-glutamine N-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + L-glutamine = CoA + N-acyl-L-glutamine.

name: BH2 domain binding
definition: Binding to a BH2 protein domain, present in Bcl-2 family members. Proteins that act as inhibitors of apoptosis harbour at least three BH domains: BH1, BH2 and BH3; the BH1 and BH2 domains are found in all death antagonists of the Bcl-2 family but only in one class of death agonists.

name: cysteine-type carboxypeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a single C-terminal amino acid residue from a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which the sulfhydryl group of a cysteine residue at the active center acts as a nucleophile.

name: 3alpha-hydroxy-ent-sandaracopimardiene 7-beta-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ent-sandaracopimaradien-3-beta-ol + NADPH + H+ + O2 = oryzalexin D + NADP + H2O.

name: inositol hexakisphosphate 6-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + 1D-myo-inositol hexakisphosphate = ADP + 6-diphospho-1D-myo-inositol (1,2,3,4,5)pentakisphosphate.

name: ferroxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 Fe2+ + 4 H+ + O2 = 4 Fe3+ + 2 H2O.

name: beta-2-microglobulin binding
definition: Binding to beta-2-microglobulin.

name: high-affinity D-glucose:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: glucose + H+ = glucose + H+. This activity is constitutive and therefore always present, regardless of demand. Symporter activity enables the active transport of a solute across a membrane by a mechanism whereby two or more species are transported together in the same direction in a tightly coupled process not directly linked to a form of energy other than chemiosmotic energy. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations.

name: syntaxin-1 binding
definition: Binding to a syntaxin-1 SNAP receptor.

name: opsonin receptor activity
definition: Combining with an opsonin and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: sulfolactate sulfo-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-sulfolactate = pyruvate + sulfite.

name: nicotinic acid riboside hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinic acid riboside + H2O = nicotinic acid + D-ribose.

name: (+)-abscisic acid 8'-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (+)-abscisate + H+ + NADPH + O2 = (+)-8'-hydroxyabscisate + H2O + NADP+.

name: mannitol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannitol + NAD+ = D-mannose + H+ + NADH.

name: voltage-gated potassium channel activity involved in bundle of His cell action potential repolarization
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a potassium ion by a voltage-gated channel through the plasma membrane of a bundle of His cell contributing to the repolarization phase of an action potential. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

name: juvenile hormone response element binding
definition: Binding to a juvenile hormone response element (JHRE), a conserved sequence found in the promoters of genes whose expression is regulated in response to juvenile hormone.

name: bile-acid 7alpha-dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7alpha,12alpha-dihydroxy-3-oxochol-4-en-24-oate = 12alpha-hydroxy-3-oxochola-4,6-dien-24-oate + H2O.

name: L-arabinose 1-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arabinose + NAD+ = L-arabinono-1,4-lactone + NADH.

name: L-aspartate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate + NAD(P)+ + H2O = oxaloacetate + NH4+ + NADPH + H+.

name: palmitoleoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a palmitoleoyl group, a 16-carbon monounsaturated fatty acid (C16:1), to an acceptor molecule.

name: microtubule lateral binding
definition: Binding to the side of a microtubule.

name: xanthine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: xanthine + H2O + O2 = urate + H2O2.

name: cyclic nucleotide phosphodiesterase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of cyclic nucleotide phosphodiesterase.

name: N-acetyl-anhydromuramoyl-L-alanine amidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GlcNAc-1,6-anhMurNAc-L-Ala-gamma-D-Glu-DAP-D-Ala + H2O glcNAc-1,6-anhMurNAc + L-Ala-gamma-D-Glu-DAP-D-Ala.

name: xyloglucan-specific endo-beta-1,4-glucanase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: xyloglucan + H2O = xyloglucan oligosaccharides. This reaction is the endohydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-glucosidic linkages in xyloglucan.

name: o-aminophenol oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 2-aminophenol + 3 O2 = 2 isophenoxazine + 6 H2O.

name: L-lactate dehydrogenase (cytochrome) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-lactate + 2 [Fe(III)cytochrome c] = 2 [Fe(II)cytochrome c] + 2 H+ + pyruvate.

name: 6-carboxymethyl-5-methyl-4-hydroxypyridin-2-ol 3-C-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-carboxymethyl-5-methyl-4-hydroxypyridin-2-ol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 6-carboxymethyl-3,5-dimethyl-4-hydroxypyridin-2-ol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

name: germacrene-D synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate = (-)-germacrene D + diphosphate.

name: glutamate racemase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate = D-glutamate.

name: fibrinogen binding
definition: Binding to fibrinogen, a highly soluble hexameric glycoprotein complex that is found in blood plasma and is converted to fibrin by thrombin in the coagulation cascade.

name: enzyme-substrate adaptor activity
definition: An adaptor that brings together an enzyme and its substrate. Adaptors recruit the substrate to its enzyme, thus contributing to substrate selection and specificity.

name: tRNA (cytidine(34)-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cytidine(34) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methylcytidine(34) in tRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: voltage-gated sodium channel activity involved in SA node cell action potential
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a sodium ion by a voltage-gated channel through the plasma membrane of an SA node cardiac muscle cell contributing to the depolarization phase of an action potential. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

name: precorrin-6A reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: precorrin-6B + NADP+ = precorrin-6A + NADPH + H+.

name: phosphoacetylglucosamine mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate = N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate.

name: borate efflux transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of borate from the inside of the cell to the outside of the cell across a membrane.

name: cinnamyl-alcohol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cinnamyl alcohol + NADP+ = cinnamaldehyde + NADPH + H+. Also acts on coniferyl alcohol, sinapyl alcohol and 4-coumaryl alcohol.

name: lipoprotein particle binding
definition: Binding to a lipoprotein particle. A lipoprotein particle, also known as a lipoprotein, is a clathrate complex consisting of a lipid enwrapped in a protein host without covalent binding in such a way that the complex has a hydrophilic outer surface consisting of all the protein and the polar ends of any phospholipids.

name: protein-lipid complex binding
definition: Binding to a protein-lipid complex, any macromolecular complex that contains both protein and lipid molecules.

name: ligand-gated monoatomic ion channel activity involved in regulation of presynaptic membrane potential
definition: Any ligand-gated ion channel activity, occurring in the presynaptic membrane, that is involved in regulation of presynaptic membrane potential.

name: NuA4 histone acetyltransferase complex binding
definition: Binding to a NuA4 histone acetyltransferase complex.

name: histone H3K4 dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N6,N6-dimethyl-L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of two methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 4 of histone H3, producing histone H3K4me2.

name: histone H3K4 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone H3 L-lysine (position 4) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + histone H3 N6-methyl-L-lysine (position 4). This reaction is the addition of up to three methyl groups to the lysine residue at position 4 of the histone H3 protein.

name: tauropine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + NAD+ + tauropine = H+ + NADH + pyruvate + taurine.

name: L-cysteine binding
definition: Binding to L-cysteine.

name: type I activin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type I activin receptor.

name: catechol oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 catechol + O2 = 2 1,2-benzoquinone + 2 H2O. This reaction catalyzes exclusively the oxidation of catechols (i.e., o-diphenols) to the corresponding o-quinones.

name: dolichal reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + NADP+ = a di-trans,poly-cis-dolichal + NADPH + H+.

name: pentraxin binding
definition: Binding to a pentraxin, a member of a family of inflammatory proteins with a radially symmetric arrangement of five identical, noncovalently linked chains in a pentagonal array.

name: GDP-4-dehydro-D-rhamnose reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-6-deoxy-D-mannose + NAD(P)+ = GDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-D-mannose + NAD(P)H + H+. In the reverse reaction, a mixture of GDP-D-rhamnose and its C-4 epimer is formed.

name: alpha-(1->6)-fucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an L-fucosyl group from GDP-beta-L-fucose to an acceptor molecule to form an alpha-(1->6) linkage.

name: galactoside 6-L-fucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an L-fucosyl group from GDP-beta-L-fucose to a galactoside acceptor molecule, usually an N-glycan, to form an alpha(1,6)-fucosylated galactoside.

name: neuromedin U binding
definition: Interacting selectively and non-covalently and stoichiometrically with neuromedin U, a hypothalamic peptide involved in energy homeostasis and stress responses.

name: neuropeptide binding
definition: Interacting selectively and non-covalently and stoichiometrically with neuropeptides, peptides with direct synaptic effects (peptide neurotransmitters) or indirect modulatory effects on the nervous system (peptide neuromodulators).

name: SCF ubiquitin ligase complex binding
definition: Binding to a SCF ubiquitin ligase complex.

name: type 2 neuropeptide Y receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 2 neuropeptide Y receptor.

name: neuropeptide Y receptor binding
definition: Binding to a neuropeptide Y receptor.

name: glycerol-phosphate:phosphate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: glycerol phosphate(out) + phosphate(in) = glycerol phosphate(in) + phosphate(out).

name: arylamine N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + an arylamine = CoA + an N-acetylarylamine.

name: protein propionyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: propionyl-CoA + lysine in peptide = CoA + N-propionyl-lysine-peptide.

name: aminomuconate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + NAD+ + 2-aminomuconate semialdehyde = NADH + 2-amino-muconate.

name: P-type divalent copper transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Cu2+(in) = ADP + phosphate + Cu2+(out).

name: complement receptor activity
definition: Combining with any component or product of the complement cascade and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: red light photoreceptor activity
definition: The function of absorbing and responding to electromagnetic radiation with a wavelength of approximately 660nm. The response may involve a change in conformation.

name: 3',2'-cyclic GMP-AMP binding
definition: Binding to 3',2' cyclic GMP-AMP (cGAMP) nucleotide, a cyclic purine dinucleotide that consists of AMP and GMP units cyclized via 3',5' and 2',5' linkages.

name: low-affinity D-glucose:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-glucose(out) + Na+(out) = D-glucose(in) + Na+(in). In low-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute only if it is present at very high concentrations.

name: D-glucose:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-glucose(out) + Na+(out) = D-glucose(in) + Na+(in).

name: hydroquinone glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydroquinone + UDP-D-glucose = H+ + hydroquinone O-beta-D-glucopyranoside + UDP.

name: cystine:glutamate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: cystine(out) + glutamate(in) = cystine(in) + glutamate(out).

name: citramalate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-citramalate = acetate + pyruvate.

name: HLA-C specific inhibitory MHC class I receptor activity
definition: Combining with a MHC class I molecule of the HLA-C subclass to mediate signaling that inhibits activation of a lymphocyte.

name: tumor necrosis factor binding
definition: Binding to tumor necrosis factor, a proinflammatory cytokine produced by monocytes and macrophages.

name: low-affinity zinc ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: Zn2+ = Zn2+, probably powered by proton motive force. In low-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute only if it is present at very high concentrations.

name: type 1 orexin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 1 orexin receptor.

name: taurocyamine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + taurocyamine = N-phosphotaurocyamine + ADP + 2 H+.

name: chondroitin 2-sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + chondroitin = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + chondroitin 2'-O-sulfate. Results in sulfation of glucuronic acid and iduronic acid residues.

name: N-sulfoglucosamine-3-sulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the 3-sulfate groups of the N-sulfo-D-glucosamine 3-O-sulfate units of heparin.

name: retroviral 3' processing activity
definition: The catalysis of the removal of two di- or tri-nucleotides from each 3' end of double-stranded viral DNA, exposing recessed 3' hydroxyls.

name: voltage-gated sodium channel activity involved in AV node cell action potential
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a sodium ion by a voltage-gated channel through the plasma membrane of an AV node cardiac muscle cell contributing to the depolarization phase of an action potential. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

name: neutral, basic amino acid:sodium:chloride symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: neutral/basic amino acid(out) + Na+(out) + Cl-(out) = neutral/basic amino acid(in) + Na+(in) + Cl-(in).

name: 3',3'-cyclic GMP-AMP binding
definition: Binding to 3',3' cyclic GMP-AMP (cGAMP) nucleotide, a cyclic purine dinucleotide that consists of AMP and GMP units cyclized via 3',5' and 3',5' linkages.

name: cyclic GMP-AMP binding
definition: Binding to cyclic GMP-AMP (cGAMP) nucleotide.

name: glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor activity
definition: Combining with glucagon-like peptide 1 and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein.

name: FAD diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: FAD + H2O = AMP + FMN.

name: phosphoglucan, water dikinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [(1->4)-6-phospho-alpha-D-glucosyl](n) + n ATP + n H2O = [(1->4)-3,6-bisphospho-alpha-alpha-glucosyl](n) + n AMP + 2n H+ + n phosphate.

name: aclacinomycin T methylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: aclacinomycin T(1+) + H2O = 15-demethylaclacinomycin T + methanol + H+.

name: linalool 8-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: linalool + 2 O2 + 2 reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = (6E)-8-oxolinalool + 2 H+ + 3 H2O + 2 oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: isoguanine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + H2O + isoguanine = NH4+ + xanthine.

name: precorrin-6A synthase (deacetylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + H2O + precorrin-5 = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + acetate + 2 H+ + precorrin-6X.

name: beta-agarase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-galactosidic linkages in agarose, giving the tetramer as the predominant product.

name: phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate) + H2O = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol) + phosphate.

name: histone H3K9 demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a modified lysine residue at position 9 of the histone H3 protein.

name: xyloglucan 1,6-alpha-xylosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of xyloglucan side chains so as to remove unsubstituted D-xylose residues attached to the glucose located at the non-reducing terminus.

name: lactaldehyde reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: propane-1,2-diol + NAD+ = lactaldehyde + NADH + H+.

name: chloroplast targeting sequence binding
definition: Binding to a chloroplast targeting sequence, a specific peptide sequence that acts as a signal to localize the protein within the chloroplast.

name: eukaryotic initiation factor 4G binding
definition: Binding to eukaryotic initiation factor 4G, a polypeptide factor involved in the initiation of ribosome-mediated translation.

name: pseudouridylate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribose 5-phosphate + uracil = H2O + pseudouridine 5'-phosphate.

name: 7-deoxyloganetic acid glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-glucose + 7-deoxyloganetate = H+ + 7-deoxyloganate + UDP.

name: 5-amino-6-(5-phosphoribosylamino)uracil reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-amino-6-(5-phosphoribitylamino)uracil + NADP+ = 5-amino-6-(5-phosphoribosylamino)uracil + H+ + NADPH.

name: low-affinity tryptophan transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the low-affinity transfer of L-tryptophan from one side of a membrane to the other. Tryptophan is 2-amino-3-(1H-indol-3-yl)propanoic acid. In low-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute only if it is present at very high concentrations.

name: folic acid transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of folic acid (pteroylglutamic acid) from one side of a membrane to the other. Folic acid is widely distributed as a member of the vitamin B complex and is essential for the synthesis of purine and pyrimidines.

name: glutaconate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + (E)-glutaconate = acetate + glutaconyl-1-CoA.

name: protein serine/threonine kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a protein serine/threonine kinase.

name: silicate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of silicates from one side of a membrane to the other. Silicates are the salts of silicic acids, and are usually composed of silicon and oxygen (Si[x]O[y]), one or more metals, and possibly hydrogen. Types of silicate include unisilicates, metasilicates and hydrous silicates.

name: type 2 neuromedin U receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 2 neuromedin U receptor.

name: globoside alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity
