definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-(1,3)-D-galactosyl-(1,4)-D-galactosyl-(1,4)-D-glucosylceramide + UDP-N-acetylgalactosamine = N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-(1,3)-D-galactosyl-(1,4)-D-galactosyl-(1,4)-D-glucosylceramide + UDP.

name: tocopherol C-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: gamma-tocopherol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = (+)-alpha-tocopherol + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction can also use delta-tocopherol, gamma-tocotrienol and delta-tocotrienol as substrates.

name: tyramine N-feruloyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: feruloyl-CoA + tyramine = CoA + N-feruloyltyramine.

name: pinosylvin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-cinnamoyl-CoA + 3 H+ + 3 malonyl-CoA = 4 CO2 + 4 CoA + pinosylvin.

name: iodotyrosine deiodinase activity
definition: Catalyzes the reaction: 2 iodide + L-tyrosine + 2 NADP+ = 3,5-diiodo-L-tyrosine + H+ + 2 NADPH. Note that this activity has only been demonstrated in the direction of 3-deiodination. 3-bromo-L-tyrosine and 3-chloro-L-tyrosine can also be used as substrates.

name: isoursodeoxycholate 7-beta-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-beta,7-beta-dihydroxy-5-beta-cholan-24-oate + NAD+ = 3-beta-hydroxy-7-oxo-5-beta-cholan-24-oate + H+ + NADH.

name: heparin-sulfate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the elimination of sulfate; appears to act on linkages between N-acetyl-D-glucosamine and uronate. Product is an unsaturated sugar.

name: P-type calcium transporter activity involved in regulation of presynaptic cytosolic calcium ion concentration
definition: A calcium-transporting P-type ATPase activity involved in regulation of presynaptic cytosolic calcium ion concentration.

name: carotenoid isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the isomerization of poly-cis-carotenoids to all-trans-carotenoids.

name: naringenin 2-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction:(2S)-naringenin + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = (2S)-2-hydroxynaringenin + H(+) + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: histone H3 arginine deiminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + histone H3 L-arginyl = histone H3 L-citrullyl + NH4+, resulting in histone H3 citrullination.

name: high-affinity copper ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a copper ions (Cu2+) from one side of a membrane to the other. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations.

name: DH domain binding
definition: Binding to a DH (Dbl homology) domain of a protein. The DH domain contains three structurally conserved regions separated by more variable regions. It is composed of 11 alpha helices that are folded into a flattened, elongated alpha-helix bundle in which two of the three conserved regions, conserved region 1 (CR1) and conserved region 3 (CR3), are exposed near the centre of one surface. CR1 and CR3, together with a part of alpha-6 and the DH/PH (pleckstrin homology) junction site, constitute the Rho GTPase interacting pocket.

name: fatty-acyl-CoA binding
definition: Binding to a fatty-acyl-CoA, any derivative of coenzyme A in which the sulfhydryl group is in thiolester linkage with a fatty acyl group.

name: 2-iminobutanoate deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-iminobutanoate + H2O = 2-oxobutanoate + NH4+.

name: germacrene A acid 8beta-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: germacra-1(10),4,11(13)-trien-12-oate + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = 8beta-hydroxygermacra-1(10),4,11(13)-trien-12-oate + H(+) + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: FK506 binding
definition: Binding to a 23-membered macrolide lactone FK506.

name: pseudouridine 5'-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pseudouridine 5'-phosphate + H2O = pseudouridine + phosphate.

name: pyranose oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose + O2 = 2-dehydro-D-glucose + H2O2.

name: licodione 2'-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + licodione = 2'-O-methyllicodione + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

name: [heparan sulfate]-glucosamine 3-sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucosaminyl-[heparan sulfate](n) + 3'-phosphoadenylyl sulfate = 3-sulfo-alpha-D-glucosaminyl-[heparan sulfate](n) + adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + H+.

name: versiconal hemiacetal acetate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: versiconol acetate + NADP = versiconal hemiacetal acetate + NADPH.

name: proteinase-activated receptor activity
definition: A G protein-coupled receptor activity that is activated by cleavage by a serine protease, exposing a tethered ligand corresponding to the new N-terminus, which binds to the receptor and activates it.

name: scavenger receptor activity
definition: Combining with any modified low-density lipoprotein (LDL) or other polyanionic ligand and delivering the ligand into the cell via endocytosis. Ligands include acetylated and oxidized LDL, Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, apoptotic cells, amyloid-beta fibrils, and advanced glycation end products (AGEs).

name: structural constituent of postsynaptic actin cytoskeleton
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of a postsynaptic actin cytoskeleton.

name: palmitoleoyl [acyl-carrier-protein]-dependent acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a palmitoleoyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + alpha-KDO-(2->4)-alpha-KDO-(2->6)-lipid IVA = KDO2-(palmitoleoyl)-lipid IVA + a holo-[acyl-carrier protein].

name: cell adhesive protein binding involved in AV node cell-bundle of His cell communication
definition: Binding to a protein or protein complex that results in the connection of an AV node cell with a bundle of His cell and contributes to the communication between the two cells.

name: type 2 vasoactive intestinal polypeptide receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 2 vasoactive intestinal polypeptide receptor.

name: IAA-Ala conjugate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: indole-3-acetyl-alanine + H2O = indole-3-acetate + L-alanine.

name: tricyclene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: geranyl diphosphate(3-) = tricyclene + diphosphoric acid.

name: dimethyl sulfide monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dimethyl sulfide + H+ + NADH + O2 = formaldehyde + H2O + methanethiol + NAD+.

name: beta-amylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (1,4-alpha-D-glucosyl)(n+1) + H2O = (1,4-alpha-D-glucosyl)(n-1) + alpha-maltose. This reaction is the hydrolysis of 1,4-alpha-glucosidic linkages in polysaccharides so as to remove successive maltose units from the non-reducing ends of the chains.

name: histone H3K79 monomethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6-methyl-L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: F-bar domain binding
definition: Binding to an F-BAR domain of a protein, a domain of about 60 residues that occurs in a wide range of cytoskeletal proteins.

name: O-fucosylpeptide 3-beta-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a alpha-D-glucose residue from UDP-alpha-D-glucose to the fucose residue of a fucosylated protein acceptor.

name: phosphogluconate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-phospho-D-gluconate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phospho-D-gluconate + H2O.

name: 3-deoxy-manno-octulosonate-8-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 8-phospho-3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonate + H2O = 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonate + phosphate.

name: beta-D-glucose oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-D-glucose + O2 = D-glucono-1,5-lactone + H2O2.

name: retinol binding
definition: Binding to retinol, vitamin A1, 2,6,6-trimethyl-1-(9'-hydroxy-3',7'-dimethylnona-1',3',5',7'-tetraenyl)cyclohex-1-ene, one of the three components that makes up vitamin A. Retinol is an intermediate in the vision cycle and it also plays a role in growth and differentiation.

name: all-trans-retinol binding
definition: Binding to all-trans-retinol.

name: branched-chain amino acid transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of branched-chain amino acids from one side of a membrane to the other. Branched-chain amino acids are amino acids with a branched carbon skeleton without rings.

name: homogentisate phytyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: homogentisate + phytyl diphosphate + H+ = 2-methyl-6-phytyl-1,4-benzoquinone + CO2 + diphosphate. 2-methyl-6-phytyl-1,4-benzoquinone is also known as 2-methyl-6-phytylplastoquinol.

name: acireductone dioxygenase [iron(II)-requiring] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-dihydroxy-5-(methylthio)pent-1-en-3-one + O2 = 4-methylthio-2-oxobutanoate + formate + H+.

name: polynucleotide adenylyltransferase activator activity
definition: Increases the activity of the enzyme polynucleotide adenylyltransferase.

name: beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosaminide alpha-2,3- sialyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosaminyl derivative + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = N-acetyl-alpha-neuraminyl-(2->3)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosaminyl derivative + CMP + H+.

name: ureidoglycine aminohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2-ureidoglycine + H2O = (S)-ureidoglycolate + NH4+.

name: DNA-3'-diphospho-5'-guanosine diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3'-end 2'-deoxyribonucleotide-3'-diphospho-5'-guanosine-DNA + H2O = a 3'-end 2'-deoxyribonucleotide 3'-phosphate-DNA + GMP + 2 H+.

name: limonoid glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + limonin = glucosyl-limonin + UDP.

name: dopamine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a dopamine receptor.

name: ATP-dependent H3-H4 histone complex chaperone activity
definition: A histone chaperone that carries a H3-H4 histone complex, driven by ATP hydrolysis.

name: epidermal growth factor receptor binding
definition: Binding to an epidermal growth factor receptor.

name: catechol 1,2-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: catechol + O2 = cis,cis-muconate.

name: guiding stereospecific synthesis activity
definition: The orientation of free radical substrates in such a way that only a particular stereoisomer is synthesized by an enzyme. Best characterized as a function during lignan biosynthesis.

name: histone H3K56 deacetylase activity, NAD-dependent
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 56) + NAD+ + H2O = histone H3 L-lysine (position 56) + 2''-O-acetyl-ADP-D-ribose + nicotinamide. This reaction transfers an acetyl group attached to a lysine residue in H3K56 to NAD, producing nicotinamide.

name: L-glutamate:prephenate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + L-arogenate = L-glutamate + prephenate.

name: ornithine decarboxylase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of ornithine decarboxylase.

name: inositol-1,2,4,5-tetrakisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 1,2,4,5-tetrakisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 1,2,4-trisphosphate + phosphate.

name: arginine deiminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + H2O = L-citrulline + NH4+.

name: D-xylulokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-xylulose + ATP = D-xylulose 5-phosphate + ADP + H+.

name: angiotensin receptor activity
definition: Combining with angiotensin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: interleukin-1, type II receptor binding
definition: Binding to a Type II interleukin-1 receptor.

name: phosphatidylethanolamine lysophospholipase A1 activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine + H2O = sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine + a fatty acid + H+.

name: L-tryptophan:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophan + 2-oxoglutarate = indole-3-pyruvate + L-glutamate.

name: transferrin receptor activity
definition: Combining selectively with transferrin, and delivering transferrin into the cell via endocytosis. Transferrin is a major iron carrier protein in vertebrates.

name: lipopolysaccharide glucosyltransferase I activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + lipopolysaccharide = UDP + D-glucosyl-lipopolysaccharide.

name: tyramine-beta hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tyramine + L-ascorbate + O2 = (R)-octopamine + L-dehydroascorbate + H2O.

name: thiol S-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + a thiol = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + a thioether.

name: ADP-ribosylglutamate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-glutamyl-[protein] + H2O = L-glutamyl-[protein] + ADP-ribose.

name: deoxyribonuclease II activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of DNA to nucleoside 3'-phosphates and 3'-phosphooligonucleotide end-products.

name: alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-(1->4)-linked alpha-D-glucose residues with release of alpha-D-glucose.

name: interleukin-1 type I receptor antagonist activity
definition: Blocks the binding of interleukin-1 to interleukin-1 type I receptors.

name: proline:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: proline(out) + Na+(out) = proline(in) + Na+(in).

name: copper-dependent protein binding
definition: Binding to a protein or protein complex, in the presence of copper.

name: histone H3K27me3 reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 trimethylated at lysine 27.

name: lysozyme inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of lysozyme.

name: chlorophenol O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + trichlorophenol = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + trichloroanisole.

name: mannose-1-phosphate guanylyltransferase (GDP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-mannose 1-phosphate + GDP + H+ = GDP-alpha-D-mannose + phosphate.

name: left-handed Z-DNA binding
definition: Binding to DNA in the Z form, i.e. a left-handed helix in which the phosphate backbone zigzags.

name: ABC-type indole transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + indole(in) = ADP + phosphate + indole(out).

name: 5'-3' RNA helicase activity
definition: Unwinding of an RNA helix in the 5' to 3' direction, driven by ATP hydrolysis.

name: acylpyruvate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-acylpyruvate + H2O = a carboxylate + pyruvate.

name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(2605) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(2605) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(2605) in 23S rRNA.

name: inositol-4,5,6-triphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 4,5,6-trisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 4,6-bisphosphate + phosphate.

name: pattern recognition receptor activity
definition: Combining with a pathogen-associated molecular pattern (PAMP), a structure conserved among microbial species to initiate an innate immune response.

name: thioglucosidase binding
definition: Binding to a thioglucosidase enzyme.

name: BH1 domain binding
definition: Binding to a BH1 protein domain, present in Bcl-2 family members. Proteins that act as inhibitors of apoptosis harbour at least three BH domains: BH1, BH2 and BH3; the BH1 and BH2 domains are found in all death antagonists of the Bcl-2 family but only in one class of death agonists.

name: dTDP-6-deoxy-L-talose 4-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dTDP-6-deoxy-L-talose + NADP+ = dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-L-mannose + H+ + NADPH.

name: pipecolic acid N-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-pipecolic acid + NAD(P)H + O2 + H+ = N-hydroxypipecolic acid + NAD(P)+ + H2O.

name: interleukin-27 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-27.

name: ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (6S)-6beta-hydroxy-1,4,5,6-tetrahydronicotinamide adenine dinucleotide + ADP = AMP + H+ + NAD(P)H + phosphate.

name: galanin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a galanin receptor.

name: lead ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of lead (Pb) ions from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: sugar-terminal-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + sugar phosphorylated on the terminal carbon = a sugar + phosphate.

name: sucrose phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sucrose + phosphate = D-fructose + alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate.

name: ATPase-coupled phosphate ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + phosphate(out) = ADP + phosphate + phosphate(in).

name: DNA topoisomerase binding
definition: Binding to a DNA topoisomerase.

name: flavonol 3-O-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + a flavonol = UDP + a flavonol 3-O-D-glucoside.

name: thrombin-activated receptor activity
definition: A G protein-coupled receptor activity that is activated by cleavage by thrombin, which exposes a tethered ligand corresponding to the new N-terminus, which binds to the receptor and activates it.

name: (iso)eugenol O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (E)-isoeugenol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = (E)-isomethyleugenol + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: very-low-density lipoprotein particle receptor binding
definition: Binding to a very-low-density lipoprotein receptor.

name: 2-hydroxyflavanone C-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3'-hydro-2'-hydroxy-beta-oxodihydrochalcone + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = a 3'-(beta-D-glucopyranosyl)-2'-hydroxy-beta-oxodihydrochalcone + H+ + UDP.

name: trans-2-enoyl-CoA reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + NAD+ = trans-didehydroacyl-CoA + NADH.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-isohexenylglutaryl-CoA lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxy-3-(4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl)glutaryl-CoA + 4 H+ = 7-methyl-3-oxooct-6-enoyl-CoA + acetate.

name: prostaglandin H2 endoperoxidase reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: prostaglandin F2alpha + NADP+ = prostaglandin H2 + NADPH + H+.

name: voltage-gated calcium channel activity involved in AV node cell action potential
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a calcium ion by a voltage-gated channel across the plasma membrane of an AV node cardiac muscle cell that contributes to the depolarization phase of an action potential. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

name: gamma-aminobutyric acid:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: gamma-aminobutyric acid(out) + H+(out) = gamma-aminobutyric acid(in) + H+(in).

name: cholecystokinin receptor activity
definition: Combining with cholecystokinin and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein to initiate a change in cell activity. Cholecystokinin can act as a neuropeptide or as a gastrointestinal hormone.

name: 2-phytyl-1,4-naphthoquinone methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: demethylphylloquinol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + phylloquinol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: 2-(S)-hydroxypropyl-CoM dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-(S)-hydroxypropyl-coenzyme M + NAD+ = 2-oxopropyl-coenzyme M + H+ + NADH.

name: dTMP kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dTMP + ATP = dTDP + ADP.

name: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase binding
definition: Binding to a mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase, a protein that can phosphorylate a MAP kinase.

name: 4-nitrophenol 4-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: p-nitrophenol + O2 + NADPH = H2O + NADP+ + nitrite + p-benzoquinone.

name: 3-beta-hydroxy-Delta5-steroid dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-beta-hydroxy-Delta(5)-steroid + NAD+ = a 3-oxo-Delta(5)-steroid + NADH + H+. Also acts on on 3-beta-hydroxypregn-5-en-20-one to form progesterone.

name: immunoglobulin binding
definition: Binding to an immunoglobulin.

name: all-trans-retinol 13,14-reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-13,14-dihydroretinol + A = all-trans-retinol + AH(2). Note that this reaction has only been observed to occur in the opposite direction.

name: protein phosphatase binding
definition: Binding to a protein phosphatase.

name: methylarsonate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 glutathione + H+ + methylarsonate = glutathione disulfide + H2O + methylarsonous acid.

name: abscisic acid transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of abscisic acid from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: linoleate 9S-lipoxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: linoleate + O2 = (9S,10E,12Z)-9-hydroperoxy-10,12-octadecadienoate.

name: UDP-3-O-acyl-N-acetylglucosamine deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + H2O = a UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-alpha-D-glucosamine + acetate.

name: (S)-cheilanthifoline synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-scoulerine + [reduced NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = (S)-cheilanthifoline + [oxidized NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + 2 H2O.

name: adenine/cytosine mispair binding
definition: Binding to a double-stranded DNA region containing an A/C mispair.

name: urea binding
definition: Binding to urea, a water-soluble carboxamide with the structure H2N-CO-NH2.

name: 7-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 7-beta-hydroxysteroid + NADP+ = a 7-oxosteroid + NADPH + H+.

name: GDP-mannose mannosyl hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-alpha-D-mannose + H2O = GDP + D-mannose + H+.

name: steviol 13-O glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: steviol + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = H+ + steviolmonoside + UDP.

name: cyclohexanol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohexanol + NAD+ = cyclohexanone + NADH + H+.

name: U2 snRNA (2'-O-methyladenosine-N6)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2'-O-methyladenosine in U2 snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = an N6-methyl-2'-O-methyladenosine in U2 snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+; methylates the 6th position of adenine residues with a pre-deposited 2'-O-methylation.

name: eupatolide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 8beta-hydroxygermacra-1(10),4,11(13)-trien-12-oate + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = eupatolide + 2 H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: inward rectifier potassium channel inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents, or reduces the activity of an inwardly rectifying potassium channel.

name: L-kynurenine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + L-kynurenine = H2O + kynurenate + L-glutamate. The product 4-(2-aminophenyl)-2,4-dioxobutanoate is converted into kynurenate by a spontaneous reaction. Also acts on 3-hydroxykynurenine to form xanthurenate.

name: GTPase motor activity
definition: A motor activity driven by GTP hydrolysis.

name: morphogen activity
definition: Acts as a trigger for a pattern specification process when present at a specific concentration within a gradient.

name: rRNA (adenine-N6,N6-)-dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the dimethylation of two adjacent adenine residues in a rRNA, using S-adenosyl-L-methionine as a methyl donor.

name: isocitrate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isocitrate = glyoxylate + succinate.

name: guanosine-5'-triphosphate,3'-diphosphate diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine 5'-triphosphate,3'-diphosphate + H2O = guanosine 5'-diphosphate,3'-diphosphate + phosphate.

name: guanine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of guanine, 2-amino-6-hydroxypurine, from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: ABC-type guanine transporter activity
definition: Catalyses the reaction: ATP + H2O + guanine(out) = ADP + phosphate + guanine(in).

name: purine nucleobase transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of purine nucleobases, one of the two classes of nitrogen-containing ring compounds found in DNA and RNA, from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: nitric oxide reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + NAD(P)+ + nitrous oxide = H+ + NAD(P)H + 2 nitric oxide.

name: hippurate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-benzoylglycine + H2O = benzoate + glycine.

name: cholestanetetraol 26-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5beta-cholestane-3alpha,7alpha,12alpha-triol + 5 H+ + 3 O2 + 6 reduced [adrenodoxin] = (25R)-3alpha,7alpha,12alpha-trihydroxy-5beta-cholestan-26-oate + 4 H2O + 6 oxidized [adrenodoxin].

name: peptide noradrenalinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-noradrenaline + L-glutaminyl-[protein] = 5-(R)-noradrenalinyl-L-glutamyl-[protein] + NH4+.

name: L-methionine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-methionine from one side of a membrane to the other. L-methionine is 2-amino-4-(methylthio)butanoic acid.

name: methionine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of methionine from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: sinapoylglucose-choline O-sinapoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-O-sinapoyl-beta-D-glucose + choline = O-sinapoylcholine + D-glucose.

name: SUMO ligase regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of a SUMO ligase.

name: neurotrophin TRK receptor binding
definition: Binding to a neurotrophin TRK receptor.

name: neurotrophin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a neurotrophin receptor.

name: K48-linked deubiquitinase activity
definition: Hydrolysis of a ubiquitin unit from a ubiquitinated protein linked via the Lys48 residue of ubiquitin.

name: high-affinity IgE receptor activity
definition: Combining with high affinity with an immunoglobulin of the IgE isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: ferric-chelate reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 a Fe(II)-siderophore + NAD+ + H+ = 2 a Fe(III)-siderophore + NADH.

name: chenodeoxycholate 7-alpha-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chenodeoxycholate + NAD+ = 7-oxolithocholate + H+ + NADH.

name: glycine dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycine + NAD+ + H2O = glyoxylate + NH4+ + NADH + H+.

name: syringetin 7-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + syringetin = 7,3',5'-O-trimethylmyricetin + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: formaldehyde transketolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-xylulose 5-phosphate + formaldehyde = glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + glycerone.

name: lanosterol O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + lanosterol = CoA + lanosterol ester.

name: methylcrotonoyl-CoA carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-methylbut-2-enoyl-CoA + ATP + bicarbonate = trans-3-methylglutaconyl-CoA + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: 1,2-alpha-L-fucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + methyl-2-alpha-L-fucopyranosyl-beta-D-galactoside = L-fucose + methyl beta-D-galactoside.

name: L-glutamate:proton antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: L-glutamate(out) + H+(in) = L-glutamate(in) + H+(out).

name: glutathione dehydrogenase (ascorbate) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dehydroascorbate + 2 glutathione = L-ascorbate + glutathione disulfide.

name: dTDP-4-dehydrorhamnose reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dTDP-6-deoxy-L-mannose + NADP+ = dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-L-mannose + H+ + NADPH.

name: D-glucose uniporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-glucose(out) = D-glucose(in).

name: adenylate cyclase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of adenylate cyclase.

name: diuretic hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with a diuretic hormone and transmitting the signal to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: caffeine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,7-dimethylxanthine + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + caffeine + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. Also converts theobromine to caffeine and 7-methylxanthine to theobromine.

name: pyrimidine nucleobase transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of pyrimidine nucleobases, one of the two classes of nitrogen-containing ring compounds found in DNA and RNA, from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: selenocysteine methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: selenocysteine + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = Se-methylselenocysteine + S-adenosyl-homocysteine.

name: glucagon receptor activity
definition: Combining with glucagon and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: methionine adenosyltransferase regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of methionine adenosyltransferase.

name: histone H3K14 ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin molecule to histone 3 at the lysine-14 residue.

name: precorrin-6Y C5,15-methyltransferase (decarboxylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine + precorrin-6Y = 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + precorrin-8X + CO2.

name: high molecular weight kininogen binding
definition: Binding to a kininogen of high molecular mass.

name: kininogen binding
definition: Binding to a kininogen, a kinin precursor.

name: hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-mevalonate + CoA + 2 NAD+ = 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA + 2 NADH.

name: protein histidine kinase binding
definition: Binding to a protein histidine kinase.

name: intermediate conductance calcium-activated potassium channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of potassium by a channel with a unit conductance of 20 to 85 picoSiemens that opens in response to stimulus by internal calcium ions. Intermediate conductance calcium-activated potassium channels are more sensitive to calcium than are large conductance calcium-activated potassium channels. Transport by a channel involves catalysis of facilitated diffusion of a solute (by an energy-independent process) involving passage through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel, without evidence for a carrier-mediated mechanism.

name: glial cell-derived neurotrophic factor receptor binding
definition: A growth factor that binds selectively and non-covalently to glial cell-derived neurotrophic factor receptors.

name: flavin-dependent sulfhydryl oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [protein]-dithiol + O2 = [protein]-disulfide + H2O2 using FAD as a cofactor, leading to formation of disulfide bridges in proteins.

name: aspartate racemase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate = D-aspartate.

name: estradiol 17-beta-dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: estradiol-17-beta + NAD(P)+ = estrone + NAD(P)H + H+. The activity can use NAD+ or NADP+ as the acceptor.

name: 7-deoxyloganin 7-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7-deoxyloganin + O2 + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = H+ + H2O + loganin + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase].

name: phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding
definition: Binding to phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate, a derivative of phosphatidylinositol in which the inositol ring is phosphorylated at the 3' position.

name: histone H1K26me2 reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H1 dimethylated at lysine 26.

name: steviolbioside glucosyltransferase activity (rebaudioside B forming)
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: steviolbioside + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = H+ + rebaudioside B + UDP.

name: glycolaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycolaldehyde + H2O + NAD+ = glycolate + 2 H+ + NADH.

name: methylisocitrate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2S,3R)-3-hydroxybutane-1,2,3-tricarboxylate = pyruvate + succinate.

name: asparagine synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-aspartate + L-glutamine = AMP + diphosphate + L-asparagine + L-glutamate.

name: all-trans-retinyl-palmitate hydrolase, all-trans-retinol forming activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-retinyl palmitate + H2O = all-trans-retinol + H+ + palmitate.

name: L-lysine N6-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + L-lysine = CoA + H+ + N6-acetyl-L-lysine.

name: pyridoxamine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of pyridoxamine from one side of a membrane to the other. Pyridoxamine, 4-(aminomethyl)-5-(hydroxymethyl)-2-methylpyridin-3-ol, is one of the vitamin B6 compounds. Pyridoxal, pyridoxamine and pyridoxine are collectively known as vitamin B6, and are efficiently converted to the biologically active form of vitamin B6, pyridoxal phosphate.

name: oxalate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + oxalate = CO2 + formate.

name: spermidine:coumaroyl CoA N-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a coumaroyl group to a nitrogen atom on the spermidine molecule.

name: interleukin-23 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-23 receptor.

name: GDP-mannose 3,5-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-mannose = GDP-L-galactose.

name: D-glutamate cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glutamate = 5-oxo-D-proline + H2O.

name: histone glutaryltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glutaryl-CoA + histone = CoA + H+ + N6-glutaryl-histone.

name: (S)-tetrahydroprotoberberine N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an (S)-7,8,13,14-tetrahydroprotoberberine + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = an (S)-cis-N-methyl-7,8,13,14-tetrahydroprotoberberine + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: 4-hydroxythreonine-4-phosphate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-(phosphooxy)-L-threonine + NAD+ = 3-amino-2-oxopropyl phosphate + CO2 + NADH.

name: acetylcholine binding
definition: Binding to acetylcholine, an acetic acid ester of the organic base choline that functions as a neurotransmitter, released at the synapses of parasympathetic nerves and at neuromuscular junctions.

name: fucosylgalactoside 3-alpha-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + glycoprotein-alpha-L-fucosyl-(1,2)-D-galactose = UDP + glycoprotein-alpha-D-galactosyl-(1,3)-(alpha-L-fucosyl-(1,2))-D-galactose.

name: histone H3Q5ser reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 serotonylated at glutamine 5.

name: G protein-coupled folate receptor activity
definition: Combining with folate and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other by activating an associated G-protein, initiating a change in cell activity.

name: 6-methylthiopropyl glucosinolate S-oxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-methylthiopropyl-glucosinolate = 6-methylsulfinylpropyl-glucosinolate.

name: CMP-N-acetylneuraminate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a CMP-N-acetylneuraminate from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: hemoglobin binding
definition: Binding to hemoglobin, an oxygen carrying, conjugated protein containing four heme groups and globin.

name: hemoglobin beta binding
definition: Binding to a hemoglobin beta chain.

name: histone H3K9 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone H3 L-lysine (position 9) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + histone H3 N6-methyl-L-lysine (position 9). This reaction is the addition of up to three methyl groups to the lysine residue at position 9 of the histone H3 protein.

name: CDP reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dCDP + thioredoxin disulfide + H2O = CDP + thioredoxin.

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine 4-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine = UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine.

name: ethanolamine ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ethanolamine = acetaldehyde + NH4+.

name: vascular endothelial growth factor binding
definition: Binding to a vascular endothelial growth factor.

name: structural constituent of postsynaptic intermediate filament cytoskeleton
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of a postsynaptic intermediate filament cytoskeleton.

name: adrenomedullin receptor activity
definition: Combining with adrenomedullin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: glycosylated region protein binding
definition: Binding to a glycosylated region of a protein.

name: 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-deoxy-D-glucose-6-phosphate + H2O = 2-deoxy-D-glucose + phosphate.

name: polyphosphate:AMP phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (polyphosphate)n + AMP = (polyphosphate)n-1 + ADP.

name: phosphoglucosamine mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate = D-glucosamine 6-phosphate.

name: cytosine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of cytosine, 4-amino-2-hydroxypyrimidine from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: (S)-stylopine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-cheilanthifoline + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = (S)-stylopine + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + 2 H2O + H+.

name: carnitine O-octanoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-carnitine + octanoyl-CoA = CoA + O-octanoyl-(R)-carnitine.

name: kaempferol 3-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: kaempferol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3-O-methylkaempferol + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: long-chain fatty acid omega-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an omega-methyl-long-chain fatty acid + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = an omega-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons.

name: SMAD binding
definition: Binding to a SMAD signaling protein.

name: sodium,bicarbonate:chloride antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction chloride(in) + 2 hydrogencarbonate(out) + Na+(out) = chloride(out) + 2 hydrogencarbonate(in) + Na+(in).

name: undecaprenol kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + undecaprenol = ADP + undecaprenyl phosphate.

name: aspartoacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acyl-L-aspartate + H2O = a fatty acid anion + L-aspartate.

name: platelet-derived growth factor binding
definition: Binding to platelet-derived growth factor.

name: dethiobiotin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7,8-diaminononanoate + ATP + CO2 = ADP + dethiobiotin + 4 H+ + phosphate.

name: complement component C4b receptor activity
definition: Combining with the C4b product of the classical complement cascade and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: inositol-1,2,4,5,6-pentakisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 1,2,4,5,6-pentakisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 1,2,4,6-tetrakisphosphate + phosphate.

name: advanced glycation end-product binding
definition: Binding to advanced glycation end-product.

name: uracil oxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: FMNH2 + NADH + O2 + uracil = (Z)-3-ureidoacrylate + FMN + H+ + H2O + NAD+. Can also use thymine as a substrate.

name: histone pre-mRNA DCP binding
definition: Binding to the downstream cleavage product (DCP) generated by histone pre-mRNA 3'-end processing.

name: xylan binding
definition: Binding to xylan.

name: L-phenylalanine N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-L-phenylalanine + CoA + H+.

name: (S)-norcoclaurine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-(2-aminoethyl)benzene-1,2-diol + 4-hydroxyphenylacetaldehyde = (S)-norcoclaurine + H2O.

name: S-adenosyl-L-methionine:benzoic acid carboxyl methyl transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzoate + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = methylbenzoate + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: anthranilate N-benzoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: anthranilate + benzoyl-CoA = N-benzoylanthranilate + CoA.

name: RNA-binding transcription regulator activity
definition: A transcription regulator activity that modulates the transcription of specific gene sets via selective and non-covalent binding to a specific RNA sequence. This function is known to occur in phages and viruses, for example the lambda N and the HIV tat proteins are necessary to allow RNA polymerase to read through terminator sequences.

name: muramyl dipeptide kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + muramyl dipeptide = ADP + H+ + 6-O-phospho-muramyl dipeptide.

name: all-trans-nonaprenyl-diphosphate synthase (geranyl-diphosphate specific) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7 isopentenyl diphosphate + (2E)-geranyl diphosphate = all-trans-nonaprenyl diphosphate + 7 diphosphate.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphate + oxaloacetate = phosphoenolpyruvate + HCO3-.

name: 3-sulfino-L-alanine: proton, glutamate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: 3-sulfino-L-alanine (cysteinesulfinate) (out) + H+(in) + L-glutamate(in) = 3-sulfino-L-alanine(in) + H+(out) + L-glutamate(out).

name: 2-chloroacrylate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2-chloropropanoate + NADP = 2-chloroacrylate + NADPH + H+.

name: neurotrophin TRKC receptor binding
definition: Binding to a neurotrophin TRKC receptor.

name: thiamine diphosphokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + thiamine = AMP + thiamine diphosphate.

name: pterocarpan synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + medicarpin = 4'-methoxyisoflavan-2',4,7-triol.

name: nuclear mineralocorticoid receptor binding
definition: Binding to a nuclear mineralocorticoid receptor.

name: morphine 6-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: morphine + NAD(P)+ = morphinone + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: nicotinamide-nucleotide amidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-nicotinamide D-ribonucleotide + H2O = nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + NH4+.

name: pyrimidine deoxyribonucleoside binding
definition: Binding to a pyrimidine deoxyribonucleoside, a compound consisting of a pyrimidine base linked to deoxyribose.

name: L-tryptophan dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophan + NAD(P)+ + H2O = indole-3-pyruvate + NH4+ + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: branched 1,3-beta-D-glucan synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + [(1->3)-beta-D-glucosyl](n) = UDP + a branched [(1->3)-beta-D-glucosyl](n+1).

name: 1,3-beta-D-glucan synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + [(1->3)-beta-D-glucosyl](n) = UDP + [(1->3)-beta-D-glucosyl](n+1).

name: glycerol-3-phosphate 2-O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an acyl-CoA + sn-glycerol 3-phosphate = CoA + a 2-acyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate.

name: phosphomevalonate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-5-phosphomevalonate + ATP = (R)-5-diphosphomevalonate + ADP + H+.

name: protein N-terminal-serine acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + N-terminal L-seryl-[protein] = CoA + H+ + N-terminal Nalpha-acetyl-L-seryl-[protein].

name: rubredoxin-NAD+ reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 reduced [rubredoxin] + NAD+ + H+ = 2 oxidized [rubredoxin] + NADH.

name: oxidoreductase activity, acting on phosphorus or arsenic in donors, with NAD(P)+ as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a phosphorus- or arsenic-containing group acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces a NAD(P)+ to NAD(P)H.

name: P-type calcium transporter activity involved in regulation of postsynaptic cytosolic calcium ion concentration
definition: A calcium-transporting P-type ATPase activity involved in regulation of postsynaptic cytosolic calcium ion concentration.

name: diacylglyceride transfer activity
definition: Directly binding to diacylglyceride and delivering it either to an acceptor molecule or to a specific location.

name: carnitine-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-carnitine + CoA + ATP = AMP + diphosphate + D-carnitinyl-CoA.

name: arginine:agmatine antiporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: arginine(out) + agmatine(in) = arginine(in) + agmatine(out).

name: cyclin binding
definition: Binding to cyclins, proteins whose levels in a cell varies markedly during the cell cycle, rising steadily until mitosis, then falling abruptly to zero. As cyclins reach a threshold level, they are thought to drive cells into G2 phase and thus to mitosis.

name: sorbose reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucitol + NADP+ = L-sorbose + H+ + NADPH. The reaction may occur, to a minor extent, in the reverse direction.

name: DNA (6-4) photolyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyrimidine-pyrimidone (6-4) photoproduct (in DNA) = 2 pyrimidine residues (in DNA). Catalyzes the reactivation of ultraviolet-irradiated DNA.

name: first spliceosomal transesterification activity
definition: Catalysis of the first transesterification reaction of spliceosomal mRNA splicing. The intron branch site adenosine is the nucleophile attacking the 5' splice site, resulting in cleavage at this position. In cis splicing, this is the step that forms a lariat structure of the intron RNA, while it is still joined to the 3' exon.

name: intracellular sodium-activated potassium channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of potassium by a channel that opens in response to stimulus by a sodium ion or ions. Transport by a channel involves facilitated diffusion of a solute (by an energy-independent process) involving passage through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel, without evidence for a carrier-mediated mechanism. Sodium activated potassium channels have distinctive properties, including a large single channel conductance, subconductance states, and a block of single channel currents at positive potentials, similar to inward rectification.

name: exo-poly-alpha-galacturonosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of pectic acid from the non-reducing end, releasing digalacturonate.

name: GTPase-dependent fusogenic activity
definition: A GTPase activity that mediates the joining of two lipid bilayers to form a single membrane.

name: N-acetylglucosaminylphosphatidylinositol deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-D-glucosaminylphosphatidylinositol + H2O = D-glucosaminylphosphatidylinositol + acetate. This reaction is the second step of the biosynthesis of glycosylphosphatidylinositol (GPI), used to anchor various eukaryotic proteins to the cell-surface membrane.

name: type 1 fibroblast growth factor receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 1 fibroblast growth factor receptor (FGFR1).

name: farnesyl diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate + H2O = (2E,6E)-farnesyl phosphate + phosphate + H+.

name: 3-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+]/C4-decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-beta-hydroxysteroid-4-alpha-carboxylate + NADP+ = a 3-oxosteroid + CO2 + NADPH.

name: P-type sodium:potassium-exchanging transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Na+(in) + K+(out) = ADP + phosphate + Na+(out) + K+(in).

name: methotrexate binding
definition: Binding to methotrexate, an antineoplastic antimetabolite with immunosuppressant properties. It is an inhibitor of tetrahydrofolate reductase and prevents the formation of tetrahydrofolate, necessary for synthesis of thymidylate, an essential component of DNA.

name: misfolded protein binding
definition: Binding to a misfolded protein.

name: geissoschizine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: geissoschizine + NADP+ = 4,21-dehydrogeissoschizine + H+ + NADPH.

name: UDP-sulfoquinovose:DAG sulfoquinovosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-sulfoquinovose + 1,2-diacylglycerol = sulfoquinovosyldiacylglycerol + UDP.

name: glycine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of glycine from one side of a membrane to the other. Glycine is aminoethanoic acid.

name: high-affinity secondary active nitrite transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of nitrite from one side of the membrane to the other, up the solute's concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a chemiosmotic source of energy. In high affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations.

name: plastoquinol--plastocyanin reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 H+[side 1] + 2 oxidized plastocyanin + plastoquinol-1 = 2 H+[side 2] + 2 reduced plastocyanin + plastoquinone. This reaction involves the concomitant transfer of 2 H+ ions across a membrane.

name: oxidoreductase activity, acting on diphenols and related substances as donors, with copper protein as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a diphenol, or related compound, acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces a copper protein.

name: (Z)-gamma-bisabolene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-trans,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate = (Z)-gamma-bisabolene + diphosphate.

name: inositol-polyphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: D-myo-inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate + H2O = myo-inositol 1,4-bisphosphate + phosphate, and 1D-myo-inositol 1,3,4,5-tetrakisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 1,3,4-trisphosphate + phosphate.

name: carbamoyl-phosphate synthase (ammonia) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 ATP + hydrogencarbonate + NH4+ = 2 ADP + carbamoyl phosphate + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: MH2 domain binding
definition: Binding to a MH2 (MAD homology 2) protein domain. The MH2 domain is found at the carboxy-terminus of MAD related proteins such as Smads. The MH2 domain mediates interaction with a wide variety of proteins and provides specificity and selectivity to Smad function and also is critical for mediating interactions in Smad oligomers.

name: 24S-hydroxycholesterol 7-alpha-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (24S)-hydroxycholesterol + O2 + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = (24S)-7alpha-dihydroxycholesterol + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase].

name: methylaspartate ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: threo-3-methyl-L-aspartate = mesaconate + NH4.

name: sodium-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other by a rotational mechanism according to the reaction: 4 Na+(in) + ATP + H2O => 4 Na+(out) + ADP + phosphate + H+.

name: L-kynurenine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-kynurenine from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: nucleoside diphosphate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + nucleoside diphosphate = ADP + nucleoside triphosphate.

name: NAD(P)HX epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: (6R)-NADHX = (6S)-NADHX and (6R)-NADPHX = (6S)-NADPHX.

name: membrane insertase activity
definition: Binds transmembrane domain-containing proteins and mediates their integration into a membrane.

name: cyanocobalamin reductase (cyanide-eliminating) (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cob(I)alamin + hydrogen cyanide + NADP+ = cyanocob(III)alamin + H+ + NADPH.

name: kaempferol 4'-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + kaempferol = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+ + kaempferide.

name: N-(4-aminobenzoyl)-L-glutamate synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-aminobenzoate + L-glutamate + ATP = N-(4-aminobenzoyl)-L-glutamate + AMP + diphosphate + H+.

name: histone H4K8 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H4 L-lysine (position 8) = CoA + histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 8).

name: ADP-glyceromanno-heptose 6-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ADP-D-glycero-D-manno-heptose = ADP-L-glycero-D-manno-heptose.

name: iota-carrageenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of 1,4-beta-D-linkages between D-galactose 4-sulfate and 3,6-anhydro-D-galactose-2-sulfate in iota-carrageenans.

name: extracellularly glutamate-gated chloride channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a chloride ion by a channel that opens when glutamate is bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts on the extracellular side of the plasma membrane.

name: pituitary adenylate cyclase activating polypeptide activity
definition: The action characteristic of pituitary adenylate cyclase activating polypeptide, a peptide produced in the hypothalamus that binds to receptors to exert pleiotropic effects including control of neurotransmitter release, vasodilation, bronchodilation, activation of intestinal motility, increase in insulin and histamine secretion, immune modulation, and stimulation of cell proliferation and differentiation.

name: N-acetylneuraminylgalactosylglucosylceramide beta-1,4-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-acetyl-alpha-neuraminyl-(2->3)-beta-D-galactosyl derivative + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosamine = an N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosaminyl-(1->4)-[N-acetyl-alpha-neuraminyl-(2->3)]-beta-D-galactosyl derivative + UDP + H+.

name: bombesin receptor activity
definition: Combining with bombesin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: gamma-tubulin binding
definition: Binding to the microtubule constituent protein gamma-tubulin.

name: N6-hydroxylysine O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-hydroxy-L-lysine + acetyl-CoA = N(6)-acetyl-N(6)-hydroxy-L-lysine + CoA.

name: deoxyribonuclease I activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of DNA to 5'-phosphodinucleotide and 5'-phosphooligonucleotide end products.

name: long-chain fatty acid transporting porin activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a long-chain fatty acid from one side of a membrane to the other. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons. This transporter is a porin and so enables the energy independent passage of substances, sized less than 1000 Da, across a membrane. The transmembrane portions of porins consist exclusively of beta-strands which form a beta-barrel. They are found in the outer membranes of Gram-negative bacteria, mitochondria, plastids and possibly acid-fast Gram-positive bacteria.

name: triplex DNA binding
definition: Binding to a DNA triple helix. The formation of triple helical DNA has been evoked in several cellular processes including transcription, replication, and recombination.

name: mono-olein transacylation activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: mono-olein + mono-olein = diolein + glycerol. Mono-olein, also known as mono-oleoylglycerol, is the monoglyceride formed from oleic acid, 9-octodecenoic acid; diolein is also known as dioleoylglycerol.

name: fimbrial usher porin activity
definition: A porin that acts in the assembly of fimbria together with fimbrial chaperone.

name: sucrose:monoatomic cation symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: sucrose(out) + monovalent cation(out) = sucrose(in) + monovalent cation(in).

name: bacteriochlorophyllide-a dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-deacetyl-3-(1-hydroxyethyl)bacteriochlorophyllide a + NAD+ = bacteriochlorophyllide a + NADH + H+.

name: oxalyl-CoA decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + oxalyl-CoA = CO2 + formyl-CoA.

name: undecaprenyl-diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + H2O = di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl phosphate + H+ + phosphate.

name: cysteine-glucosaminylinositol ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(2-amino-2-deoxy-alpha-D-glucopyranoside)-1D-myo-inositol + L-cysteine + ATP = 1-D-myo-inosityl-2-L-cysteinylamido-2-deoxy-alpha-D-glucopyranoside + AMP + diphosphate + 2 H+. 1-(2-amino-2-deoxy-alpha-D-glucopyranoside)-1D-myo-inositol is also known as glucosaminyl-inositol or GlcN-Ins, and 1-D-myo-inosityl-2-L-cysteinylamido-2-deoxy-alpha-D-glucopyranoside as desacetylmycothiol or Cys-GlcN-Ins.

name: exoribonuclease H activity
definition: Catalysis of the exonucleolytic cleavage of RNA to 5'-phosphomonoester oligonucleotides in both 5' to 3' and 3' to 5' directions.

name: sepiapterin deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-sepiapterin + H2O + H+ = (S)-xanthopterin-B2 + NH4+.

name: calmodulin-activated dual specificity 3',5'-cyclic-GMP, 3',5'-cyclic-AMP phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: 3',5'-cyclic AMP + H2O = AMP + H+ and 3',5'-cyclic GMP + H2O = GMP + H+; this activity is activated by binding to calcium-bound calmodulin.

name: protein-N-terminal asparagine amidohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-terminal L-asparaginyl-[protein] + H+ + H2O = N-terminal L-aspartyl-[protein] + NH4+. This reaction is the deamidation of an N-terminal asparagine residue in a peptide or protein.

name: K63-linked polyubiquitin modification-dependent protein binding
definition: Binding to a protein upon poly-ubiquitination formed by linkages between lysine residues at position 63 in the target protein.

name: melanocyte-stimulating hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with melanocyte-stimulating hormone to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: 4-nitrophenol 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-nitrophenol + H+ + NADH + O2 = 4-nitrocatechol + H2O + NAD+.

name: secalciferol 1-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction:2 H+ + O2 + 2 reduced [adrenodoxin] + secalciferol = calcitetrol + H2O + 2 oxidized [adrenodoxin].

name: RNA polymerase II intronic transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding
definition: Binding to an RNA polymerase II intronic DNA sequence that regulates the transcription of the transcript it is contained within.

name: intronic transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding
definition: Binding to an intronic DNA sequence that regulates the transcription of the transcript it is contained within.

name: L-serine conjugated cholate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholate + L-serine = L-serocholate + H2O.

name: D-dopachrome decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-dopachrome + H+ = 5,6-dihydroxyindole + CO2.

name: threonine-phosphate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-phospho-L-threonine + H+ = (R)-1-aminopropan-2-yl phosphate + CO2.

name: histone H4K20me3 reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H4 trimethylated at lysine 20.

name: phenylglyoxylate dehydrogenase (acylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CoA + NAD+ + phenylglyoxylate = benzoyl-CoA + CO2 + NADH.

name: beta-catenin destruction complex binding
definition: Binding to a beta-catenin destruction complex.

name: 6-hydroxynicotinate 3-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the oxidative decarboxylation of 6-hydroxynicotinate to 2,5-dihydroxypyridine, dependent on O2, NADH +H+ and FAD.

name: phosphoglucomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate = alpha-D-glucose 6-phosphate.

name: DNA ligase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + deoxyribonucleotide(n) + deoxyribonucleotide(m) = AMP + nicotinamide nucleotide + deoxyribonucleotide(n+m).

name: brain-derived neurotrophic factor binding
definition: Binding to brain-derived neurotrophic factor.

name: neurotrophin binding
definition: Binding to a neurotrophin, any of a family of growth factors that prevent apoptosis in neurons and promote nerve growth.

name: L-cysteine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteine + 2-oxoglutarate = 2-oxo-3-sulfanylpropanoate + L-glutamate.

name: 3-oxosteroid 1-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-oxosteroid + acceptor = a 3-oxo-D1-steroid + reduced acceptor.

name: inhibitory MHC class Ib receptor activity
definition: Combining with a MHC class Ib protein complex to mediate signaling that inhibits activation of a lymphocyte.

name: mast cell secretagogue receptor activity
definition: Combining with basic secretagogues to initiate pseudo-allergic reactions in mast cells.

name: phosphodiesterase activity, acting on 3'-phosphoglycolate-terminated DNA strands
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolytic removal of phosphoglycolate from the 3'-terminus of a 3'-phosphoglycolate-terminated DNA strand.

name: L-arabinose reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arabitol + NADP+ = L-arabinose + NADPH + H+.

name: icosatetraenoic acid binding
definition: Binding to icosatetraenoic acid, any straight-chain fatty acid with twenty carbon atoms and four double bonds per molecule.

name: adenosine 5'-monophosphoramidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine 5'-monophosphoramidate + H2O = AMP + NH4+. Other substrates include AMP-morpholidate, AMP-N-alanine methyl ester and AMP-alpha-acetyl lysine methyl ester.

name: L-lysine:2-oxoglutarate 6-transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + L-lysine = L-glutamate + allysine.

name: phosphopentomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribose 1-phosphate = D-ribose 5-phosphate. Also converts 2-deoxy-alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate into 2-deoxy-D-ribose 5-phosphate.

name: cytosine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cytosine + H2O = uracil + NH4+.

name: histone isonicotinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isonicotinyl-CoA + histone = coA + N(6)-isonicotinyl-histone.

name: type 2 galanin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 2 galanin receptor.

name: L-serine hydro-lyase (adding indole, L-tryptophan-forming) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: indole + L-serine = L-tryptophan + H2O.

name: gibberellin transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of gibberellin from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: D-glutaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glutamine + H2O = D-glutamate + NH4+.

name: sulfathiazole transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of sulfathiazole from one side of a membrane to the other. Sulfathiazole is an antibacterial agent of the sulfonamide group.

name: dynein light chain binding
definition: Binding to a light chain of the dynein complex.

name: galactose oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-galactose + O2 = D-galacto-hexodialdose + H2O2.

name: 5'-(N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-[mRNA] diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-end (N2,N2,N7-trimethyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA + H2O = a 5'-end diphospho-ribonucleoside in mRNA + 2 H+ + N7-methyl-GMP. Can also use (N7-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA as a substrate.

name: D-lactate dehydrogenase (cytochrome) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-lactate + 2 [Fe(III)cytochrome c] = 2 [Fe(II)cytochrome c] + 2 H+ + pyruvate.

name: structural constituent of pupal chitin-based cuticle
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of the chitin-based cuticle of a pupa. An example of this is found in Drosophila melanogaster.

name: group III metabotropic glutamate receptor activity
definition: A G protein-coupled receptor that is activated by L-AP-4 and inhibits adenylate cyclase activity.

name: trimethylamine-oxide aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + trimethylamine N-oxide = dimethylamine + formaldehyde.

name: protein-phosphocysteine-L-ascorbate-phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein S-phosphocysteine + L-ascorbate(out) = protein cysteine + L-ascorbate-6-phosphate(in).

name: CX3C chemokine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a CX3C chemokine receptor.

name: CD40 receptor binding
definition: Binding to CD40, a receptor found on the surface of all B-lymphocytes.

name: histone H3K9me2/H3K9me3 demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a tri or a dimethyl-lysine residue at position 9 of the histone H3 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate.

name: arachidonate 11,12-epoxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of an NADPH- and oxygen-dependent reaction that converts arachidonic acid to cis-11,12-epoxyeicosatrienoic acid.

name: benzaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzaldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = benzoate + NADH + H+.

name: proline-rich region binding
definition: Binding to a proline-rich region, i.e. a region that contains a high proportion of proline residues, in a protein.

name: nicotinamide riboside hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinamide riboside + H2O = nicotinamide + D-ribose.

name: 4-hydroxybutyrate receptor activity
definition: Combining with 4-hydroxybutyrte to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: citryl-CoA lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3S)-citryl-CoA = acetyl-CoA + oxaloacetate.

name: pseudophosphatase activity
definition: Maintains the phosphorylation state of certain molecules by associating with them and preventing them from associating with active phosphatases, and thus inhibiting the enzyme activity without interacting with the enzyme. Often pertains to proteins belonging to dual-specificity phosphatase family but lacking critical active site residues.

name: phosphatase regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of a phosphatase, an enzyme which catalyzes of the removal of a phosphate group from a substrate molecule.

name: phosphatase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a phosphatase.

name: inositol-1,4,5,6-tetrakisphosphate 6-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 1,4,5,6-tetrakisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate + phosphate.

name: tocopherol cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: delta-tocopherol = 2-methyl-6-phytyl-1,4-benzene-1,4-diol, gamma-tocopherol = 2,3-dimethyl-6-phytylbenzene-1,4-diol. delta-tocotrienol = 6-geranylgeranyl-2-methylbenzene-1,4-diol gamma-tocotrienol, and = 6-geranylgeranyl-2,3-dimethylbenzene-1,4-diol.

name: GDP-galactose:mannose-1-phosphate guanylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-beta-L-galactose + alpha-D-mannose 1-phosphate = GDP-alpha-D-mannose + beta-L-galactose-1-phosphate.

name: proton-dependent oligopeptide secondary active transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a oligopeptide from one side of a membrane to the other, up its concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by proton movement.

name: myosin II light chain binding
definition: Binding to a light chain of a myosin II complex.

name: S-adenosyl-L-methionine:(S)-corytuberine-N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-corytuberine + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = magnoflorine + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: 2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydro-p-cumate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydro-p-cumate + NAD+ = 2,3-dihydroxy-p-cumate + H+ + NADH.

name: 3',4',5'-trimethylmyricetin 3-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3',4',5'-O-trimethylmyricetin + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3,3',4',5'-O-tetramethylmyricetin + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: linamarin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile = UDP + linamarin.

name: endoribonuclease inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of endoribonuclease.

name: low-affinity IgG receptor activity
definition: Combining with low affinity with an immunoglobulin of an IgG isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: 4-hydroxycyclohexanecarboxylate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-4-hydroxycyclohexanecarboxylate + NAD+ = 4-oxocyclohexanecarboxylate + H+ + NADH.

name: 2,5-dihydroxypyridine 5,6-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + O2 + 2,5-dihydroxypyridine = formate + maleamate.

name: succinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a succinyl (3-carboxypropanoyl) group to an acceptor molecule.

name: N,N'-diacetylbacillosaminyl-diphospho-undecaprenol alpha-1,3-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N,N'-diacetyl-alpha-D-bacillosaminyl-diphospho-tri-trans,hepta-cis-undecaprenol + UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine = N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-alpha-(1->3)-N,N'-diacetyl-alpha-D-bacillosaminyl-diphospho-tri-trans,hepta-cis-undecaprenol + UDP + H+.

name: broad specificity neutral L-amino acid:basic L-amino acid antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: basic L-amino acid(in) + neutral L-amino acid(out) = basic L-amino acid(in) + neutral L-amino acid(out).

name: CCR1 chemokine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a CCR1 chemokine receptor.

name: glucan 1,6-alpha-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in (1->6)-alpha-D-glucans and derived oligosaccharides.

name: aspartate 4-decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate = L-alanine + CO2.

name: glucagon family peptide binding
definition: Binding to a member of the glucagon family peptide hormone (e.g. glucagon, glucagon-like peptides, oxyntomodulin, glicentin, ADCYAP1, GHRH, secretin, VIP, GIP).

name: pyridoxal transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of pyridoxal from one side of a membrane to the other. Pyridoxal, 3-hydroxy-5-(hydroxymethyl)-2-methyl-4-pyridinecarboxaldehyde, is one of the vitamin B6 compounds. Pyridoxal, pyridoxamine and pyridoxine are collectively known as vitamin B6, and are efficiently converted to the biologically active form of vitamin B6, pyridoxal phosphate.

name: (R,R)-butanediol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reversible reaction: (R,R)-butane-2,3-diol + NAD+ = (R)-acetoin + NADH + H+.

name: myosin VI head/neck binding
definition: Binding to the head/neck region of a myosin VI heavy chain.

name: type II interferon binding
definition: Binding to type II interferon, also known as interferon-gamma.

name: alkane 1-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: octane + reduced rubredoxin + O2 = 1-octanol + oxidized rubredoxin + H2O.

name: NAD DNA ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of the ADP-ribose group of NAD+ to a residue in double-stranded DNA.

name: N-acylsphingosine galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acylsphing-4-enine + UDP-alpha-D-galactose = a beta-D-galactosyl-(1<->1')-N-acylsphing-4-enine + H+ + UDP.

name: IkappaB kinase complex binding
definition: Binding to a IkappaB kinase complex.

name: flavanone 2-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a flavanone + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = a 2-hydroxyflavanone + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: prostaglandin D2 11-ketoreductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: prostaglandin D2 + H+ + NADPH = 11-epi-prostaglandin F2alpha + NADP+.

name: zf-TRAF domain binding
definition: Binding to a TRAF-type zinc finger domain of a protein.

name: 3-hydroxypropionyl-CoA dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxypropionyl-CoA = acryloyl-CoA + H2O.

name: (-)-isopiperitenone reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (6R)-isoperitenone + H+ + NADPH = (2R,5R)-isopulegone + NADP+.

name: alcohol sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + an alcohol = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + an alkyl sulfate.

name: proline racemase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-proline = D-proline.

name: mannan binding
definition: Binding to mannan.

name: histone H3K9 deacetylase activity, NAD-dependent
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 9) + NAD+ + H2O = histone H3 L-lysine (position 9) + 2''-O-acetyl-ADP-D-ribose + nicotinamide. This reaction transfers an acetyl group attached to a lysine residue in H3K9 to NAD, producing nicotinamide.

name: chondroitin-sulfate-ABC exolyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the exolytic cleavage of disaccharide residues from the non-reducing ends of both polymeric chondroitin sulfates and their oligosaccharide fragments.

name: 2,3-dihydro-2,3-dihydroxybenzoate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2S,3S)-2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydrobenzoate + NAD+ = 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate + H+ + NADH.

name: MHC class II receptor activity
definition: Combining with an MHC class II protein complex and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: U6 snRNA (guanine-N(2))-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine in U6 snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(2)-methylguanosine in U6 snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: L-leucine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction:L-leucine + 2-oxoglutarate = 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoate + L-glutamate.

name: membrane protein dislocase activity
definition: The activity of removing a protein from a membrane, by binding to a transmembrane helical fragment of a tail-anchored protein and releasing it from the the hydrophobic region of one or both lipid bilayers. The reaction is driven by ATP hydrolysis.

name: molybdenum cofactor guanylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction GTP + molybdenum cofactor = diphosphate + guanylyl molybdenum cofactor.

name: vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 1 binding
definition: Binding to a vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 1.

name: structural constituent of ribosome
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of the ribosome.

name: cyclic nucleotide-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: cNMP-dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

name: biphenyl 2,3-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: biphenyl + NADH + H+ + O2 = (2R,3S)-3-phenylcyclohexa-3,5-diene-1,2-diol + NAD+. This reaction requires Fe2+.

name: protein serine pyrophosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein phospho-serine + inositol 5-triphosphate pentakisphosphate = protein diphospho-serine + inositol 5-diphosphate pentakisphosphate.

name: 8-hydroxygeraniol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (6E)-8-hydroxygeraniol + 2 NADP = (6E)-8-oxogeranial + 2 NADPH + 2 H+.

name: 5-diphosphoinositol pentakisphosphate 1-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + 1D-myo-inositol 5-diphosphate pentakisphosphate = ADP + 1D-myo-inositol bisdiphosphate tetrakisphosphate.

name: mitogen-activated protein kinase binding
definition: Binding to a mitogen-activated protein kinase.

name: fumarylpyruvate hydrolase activity
