name: bioactive lipid receptor activity
definition: Combining with a bioactive lipid and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex. A bioactive lipid is a lipid for which changes in lipid levels result in functional consequences in a variety of cellular processes.

name: histone H3R17 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + (histone H3)-arginine (position 17) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + (histone H3)-N-methyl-arginine (position 17). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the arginine residue at position 17 of histone H3.

name: agmatine deiminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: agmatine + H2O = N-carbamoylputrescine + NH4+.

name: L-tyrosine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine + 2-oxoglutarate = 3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate + L-glutamate.

name: phosphothreonine residue binding
definition: Binding to a phosphorylated threonine residue within a protein.

name: sodium channel inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents, or reduces the activity of a sodium channel.

name: histone H3K79 trimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3 H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of up to three methyl group to the lysine residue at position 79 of the histone H3 protein, producing H3K79me3.

name: small ribosomal subunit rRNA binding
definition: Binding to small ribosomal subunit RNA (SSU rRNA), a constituent of the small ribosomal subunit. In S. cerevisiae, this is the 18S rRNA.

name: glycine binding
definition: Binding to glycine, aminoethanoic acid.

name: acyl-[acyl-carrier-protein]-phospholipid O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + O-(2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho)ethanolamine = [acyl-carrier protein] + O-(1-beta-acyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho)ethanolamine.

name: poly(A) binding
definition: Binding to a sequence of adenylyl residues in an RNA molecule, such as the poly(A) tail, a sequence of adenylyl residues at the 3' end of eukaryotic mRNA.

name: L-ascorbate:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: L-ascorbate(out) + Na+(out) = L-ascorbate(in) + Na+(in).

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine diphosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + UTP = diphosphate + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine.

name: pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring) kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-seryl-[pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit] = ADP + H+ + O-phospho-L-seryl-[pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit].

name: 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol + ATP = a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 3-phosphate + ADP + H+.

name: all-trans-retinol dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-retinol + NADP+ = all-trans-retinal + NADPH + H+.

name: lipopolysaccharide immune receptor activity
definition: Combining with a lipopolysaccharide and transmitting the signal across the cell membrane to initiate an innate immune response. Lipopolysaccharides (LPS) are major components of the outer membrane of Gram-negative bacteria, making them prime targets for recognition by the immune system.

name: interleukin-2 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-2.

name: tRNA dimethylallyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine(37) in tRNA + dimethylallyl diphosphate = N(6)-dimethylallyladenosine(37) in tRNA + diphosphate.

name: 2',3'-cyclic GMP-AMP binding
definition: Binding to 2',3' cyclic GMP-AMP (cGAMP) nucleotide, a cyclic purine dinucleotide that consists of AMP and GMP units cyclized via 2',5' and 3',5' linkages.

name: dipeptidyl-peptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of N-terminal dipeptides from a polypeptide chain.

name: galactose-6-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-galactose 6-phosphate = D-tagatose 6-phosphate.

name: NAD+-protein-aspartate ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartyl-[protein] + NAD+ = 4-O-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-aspartyl-[protein] + nicotinamide.

name: polynucleotide 5'-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-phosphopolynucleotide + H2O = a polynucleotide + phosphate.

name: ceramide 1-phosphate binding
definition: Binding to ceramide 1-phosphate.

name: aspartate ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate = fumarate + NH4+.

name: fibroblast growth factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with a fibroblast growth factor receptor ligand and transmitting the signal across the plasma membrane to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: chitosanase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of beta-1,4-linkages between N-acetyl-D-glucosamine and D-glucosamine residues in a partly acetylated chitosan.

name: N-methyl-L-amino-acid oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-methyl-L-amino acid + H2O + O2 = an L-amino acid + formaldehyde + H2O2.

name: 3-dehydro-L-gulonate-6-phosphate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-dehydro-L-gulonate 6-phosphate + H+ = L-xylulose 5-phosphate + CO2.

name: GPI-anchor transamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the formation of the linkage between a protein and a glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchor. The reaction probably occurs by subjecting a peptide bond to nucleophilic attack by the amino group of ethanolamine-GPI, transferring the protein from a signal peptide to the GPI anchor.

name: O-phospho-L-serine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-phospho-L-serine + 2-oxoglutarate = 3-phosphonooxypyruvate + L-glutamate.

name: alcohol dehydrogenase (cytochrome c(L)) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 [Fe(III)cytochrome cL] + a primary alcohol = 2 [Fe(II)cytochrome cL] + an aldehyde + 2 H+.

name: L-leucine binding
definition: Binding to L-leucine, 2-amino-4-methylpentanoic acid.

name: cysteine-S-conjugate beta-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-substituted L-cysteine + H2O = a thiol + NH4+ + pyruvate.

name: aspartic-type endopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which a water molecule bound by the side chains of aspartic residues at the active center acts as a nucleophile.

name: chromo shadow domain binding
definition: Binding to a chromo shadow domain, a protein domain that is distantly related, and found in association with, the chromo domain.

name: neurotrophin p75 receptor binding
definition: Binding to a neurotrophin p75 receptor.

name: RNA-directed RNA polymerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n+1); uses an RNA template, i.e. the catalysis of RNA-template-directed extension of the 3'-end of an RNA strand by one nucleotide at a time.

name: histone H4R3 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + (histone H4)-arginine (position 3) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + (histone H4)-N-methyl-arginine (position 3). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the arginine residue at position 3 of histone H4, producing histone H4R3me.

name: S-nitrosoglutathione reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADPH + S-nitrosoglutathione = NADP+ + S-(hydroxysulfenamide)glutathione.

name: signal recognition particle binding
definition: Binding to a signal recognition particle.

name: fructose binding
definition: Binding to the D- or L-enantiomer of fructose, the ketohexose arabino-hex-2-ulose.

name: tagatose-6-phosphate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-tagatose 6-phosphate = ADP + D-tagatose 1,6-bisphosphate.

name: NAD+-protein-cysteine ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteinyl-[protein] + NAD+ = H+ + nicotinamide + S-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-cysteinyl-[protein].

name: catechol O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a catechol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a guaiacol + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. Acts on catechols and on catecholamines such as adrenaline or noradrenaline.

name: TFIIB-class transcription factor binding
definition: Binding to a general RNA polymerase II transcription factor of the TFIIB class, one of the factors involved in formation of the preinitiation complex (PIC) by RNA polymerase II.

name: tRNA-guanosine(34) queuine transglycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine34 in tRNA + queuine = guanine + queuosine34 in tRNA.

name: potassium ion leak channel activity
definition: Enables the transport of a potassium ion across a membrane via a narrow pore channel that is open even in an unstimulated or 'resting' state.

name: type I interferon receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interferon-type I receptor, a heterodimeric complex composed of an alpha subunit (IFNAR1) and a beta subunit (IFNAR2).

name: type 1 melanocortin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 1 melanocortin receptor.

name: threonine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-threonine = 2-oxobutanoate + NH4.

name: beta-adrenergic receptor kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [beta-adrenergic receptor] + ATP = [beta-adrenergic receptor]-phosphate + ADP + H+.

name: 6-deoxy-6-sulfofructose-1-phosphate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction 6-deoxy-6-sulfofructose-1-phosphate = 3-sulfolactaldehyde + dihydroxyacetone phosphate.

name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(955/2504/2580) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(955/2504/2580) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(955/2504/2580) in 23S rRNA.

name: intracellularly cAMP-activated cation channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a cation by a channel that opens when intracellular cAMP has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: receptor ligand inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and decreases the activity of the ligand of a signaling receptor.

name: beta-fructofuranosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a fructofuranosylated fructofuranosyl acceptor + H2O = a non fructofuranosylated fructofuranosyl acceptor + a beta-D-fructofuranoside.

name: 3-deoxy-8-phosphooctulonate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-arabinose 5-phosphate + H2O + phosphoenolpyruvate = 8-phospho-3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonate + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: aldose 1-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose = beta-D-glucose. Also acts on L-arabinose, D-xylose, D-galactose, maltose and lactose.

name: 7SK snRNA binding
definition: Binding to a 7SK small nuclear RNA (7SK snRNA).

name: 13-lipoxin reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 15-oxo-(5S,6R)-dihydroxy-(7E,9E,11Z,13E)-eicosatetraenoate + NADH + H+ = 15-oxo-(5S,6R)-dihydroxy-(7E,9E,11Z)-eicosatrienoate + NAD+.

name: benzoate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + benzoate + CoA = AMP + benzoyl-CoA + diphosphate.

name: 3alpha,7alpha,12alpha-trihydroxy-5beta-cholestanoyl-CoA 24-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (25R)-3alpha,7alpha,12alpha-trihydroxy-5beta-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA + H2O + acceptor = (24R,25R)-3alpha,7alpha,12alpha,24-tetrahydroxy-5beta-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA + reduced acceptor.

name: uracil phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: diphosphate + UMP = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + uracil.

name: calcitonin gene-related peptide receptor activity
definition: Combining with a calcitonin gene-related polypeptide (CGRP) to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: tetrahydromethanopterin S-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-methyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin + coenzyme M + 2 Na+(in) = 5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin + methyl-coenzyme M + 2 Na+(out). 2-(methylthio)ethanesulfonate is also known as methyl-CoM.

name: armadillo repeat domain binding
definition: Binding to an armadillo repeat domain, an approximately 40 amino acid long tandemly repeated sequence motif first identified in the Drosophila segment polarity protein armadillo. Arm-repeat proteins are involved in various processes, including intracellular signaling and cytoskeletal regulation.

name: guanosine phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine + phosphate = alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate + guanine.

name: phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-[(R)-4-phosphonatopantothenoyl]-L-cysteinate + H+ = CO2 + pantetheine 4'-phosphate.

name: androgen binding
definition: Binding to an androgen, a male sex hormone.

name: pyruvate carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + bicarbonate + pyruvate = ADP + 2 H+ + oxaloacetate + phosphate.

name: diacylglycerol O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + 1,2-diacylglycerol = CoA + triacylglycerol.

name: N,N-dimethylaniline monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N,N-dimethylaniline + NADPH + H+ + O2 = N,N-dimethylaniline N-oxide + NADP+ + H2O.

name: mannan endo-1,4-beta-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the random hydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-mannosidic linkages in mannans, galactomannans, glucomannans, and galactoglucomannans.

name: peroxisome matrix targeting signal-1 binding
definition: Binding to a type 1 peroxisome targeting signal, a tripeptide with the consensus sequence (S/A/C)-(K/R/H)-L.

name: type II interferon receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type II interferon receptor. Type II interferon is also known as interferon-gamma.

name: calmodulin-lysine N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + calmodulin L-lysine = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + calmodulin N6-methyl-L-lysine.

name: quercetin 3-O-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a glucosyl group from UDP-glucose to the 3-hydroxy group of a quercetin molecule.

name: branched-chain 2-oxo acid dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[dihydrolipoyllysine-residue (2-methylpropanoyl)transferase] + 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + H+ = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-2-methylpropanoyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[dihydrolipoyllysine-residue (2-methylpropanoyl)transferase] + CO2. Also acts on 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoate and (S)-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate, so that it acts on the 2-oxo acids that derive from the action of transaminases on valine, leucine and isoleucine.

name: N-acetyl-beta-glucosaminyl-derivative 4-beta-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosamine = an N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosaminyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + UDP + H+.

name: structural constituent of postsynaptic density
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of a postsynaptic density.

name: alpha,alpha-trehalase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha,alpha-trehalose + H2O = 2 D-glucose.

name: type II activin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type II activin receptor.

name: choline dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: A + choline = AH(2) + betaine aldehyde.

name: calcitonin receptor activity
definition: Combining with calcitonin and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: phosphorylase kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 ATP + 2 phosphorylase b = 4 ADP + phosphorylase a.

name: 2-polyprenyl-6-hydroxyphenol methylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-(all-trans-polyprenyl)benzene-1,2-diol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 2-methoxy-6-(all-trans-polyprenyl)phenol + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with thyroid-stimulating hormone to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: ABC-type taurine transporter transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of taurine from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + taurine(out) = ADP + phosphate + taurine(in).

name: benzodiazepine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a peripheral benzodiazepine receptor (PBR).

name: 3-deoxyglucosone dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-deoxyglucosone + H2O + NAD+ = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + 2 H+ + NADH.

name: UDP-4-amino-4-deoxy-L-arabinose formyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 10-formyltetrahydrofolate + UDP-4-amino-4-deoxy-beta-L-arabinopyranose = 5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + UDP-4-deoxy-4-formamido-beta-L-arabinopyranose.

name: chorismate mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chorismate = prephenate.

name: transcription regulator inhibitor activity
definition: A molecular function regulator that inhibits the activity of a transcription regulator via direct binding and/or post-translational modification.

name: preQ1 synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7-aminomethyl-7-carbaguanine + 2 NADP+ = 7-cyano-7-deazaguanine + 2 NADPH + 3 H+.

name: 2-methoxy-6-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-methoxy-6-all-trans-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 6-methoxy-3-methyl-2-all-trans-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

name: succinyldiaminopimelate:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-succinyl-(2S,6S)-2,6-diaminopimelate + 2-oxoglutarate = (S)-2-succinylamino-6-oxoheptanedioate + L-glutamate.

name: vasopressin receptor activity
definition: Combining with vasopressin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: structural constituent of virion
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of a virion.

name: cupric reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 Cu2+ + NADH = 2 Cu+ + H+ + NAD+.

name: quinate 3-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (-)-quinate + NAD+ = (-)-3-dehydroquinate + NADH + H+.

name: TRAIL binding
definition: Binding to TRAIL (TNF-related apoptosis inducing ligand), a member of the tumor necrosis factor ligand family that rapidly induces apoptosis in a variety of transformed cell lines.

name: nucleocytoplasmic carrier activity
definition: Binding to and carrying a cargo between the nucleus and the cytoplasm by moving along with the cargo. The cargo can be either a RNA or a protein.

name: protein phosphatase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a protein phosphatase.

name: monoamine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RCH2NHR' + H2O + O2 = RCHO + R'NH2 + H2O2.

name: mu-type opioid receptor binding
definition: Binding to a mu-type opioid receptor.

name: heptose-1-phosphate adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-beta-D-heptose-1-phosphate + ATP = ADP-D-glycero-D-manno-heptose.

name: mRNA 5'-cap (guanine-N7-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + G(5')pppR-RNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + m7G(5')pppR-RNA. m7G(5')pppR-RNA is mRNA containing an N7-methylguanine cap; R may be guanosine or adenosine.

name: interleukin-3 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-3 receptor.

name: glucan 1,3-alpha-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal (1->3)-alpha-D-glucosidic links in 1,3-alpha-D-glucans.

name: quinate 3-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: quinate + NADP+ = 3-dehydroquinate + NADPH + H+.

name: talin binding
definition: Binding to a talin, a family of related cytoskeletal proteins that play a role in assembly of actin filaments and migration of various cell types.

name: phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate) + H2O = 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-3,4-bisphosphate) + phosphate.

name: syndecan binding
definition: Binding to syndecan, an integral membrane proteoglycan (250-300 kDa) associated largely with epithelial cells.

name: tRNA nucleotidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tRNA(n+1) + phosphate = tRNA(n) + a nucleoside diphosphate.

name: rRNA (cytosine-N4-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a cytidine in rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = an N(4)-methylcytidine in rRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: 6-phosphogluconolactonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-O-phosphono-D-glucono-1,5-lactone + H2O = 6-phospho-D-gluconate + H+.

name: CTP synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + UTP + glutamine + H20= ADP + phosphate + CTP + glutamate.

name: alpha-L-arabinofuranosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing alpha-L-arabinofuranoside residues in alpha-L-arabinosides.

name: tubulin deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl(alpha-tubulin) + H2O = alpha-tubulin + acetate.

name: glycerate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glycerate + ATP = 3-phospho-D-glycerate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: Pyrin domain binding
definition: Binding to a Pyrin (PAAD/DAPIN) domain, a protein-protein interaction domain that has the same fold as the Death domain.

name: ribonuclease T2 activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a ribonucleotidyl-ribonucleotide-RNA + H2O = a 3'-end 3'-phospho-ribonucleotide-RNA + a 5'-end dephospho-ribonucleoside-RNA + H+. This reaction is a two-stage endonucleolytic cleavage to nucleoside 3'-phosphates and 3'-phosphooligonucleotides with 2',3'-cyclic phosphate intermediates.

name: fructan beta-fructosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing 2,1- and 2,6-linked beta-D-fructofuranose residues in fructans.

name: histone H4K20 demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of the methyl group from a modified lysine residue at position 20 of the histone H4 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphoenolpyruvate = 3-phosphonopyruvate.

name: folic acid binding
definition: Binding to folic acid, pteroylglutamic acid. Folic acid is widely distributed as a member of the vitamin B complex and is essential for the synthesis of purine and pyrimidines.

name: L-malate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-malate + a quinone = oxaloacetate + a quinol. Vitamin K (menaquinone) and several other quinones can act as acceptors.

name: UDP-N-acetylmuramate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetylmuramate + NADP+ = UDP-N-acetyl-3-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-D-glucosamine + NADPH + H+.

name: PTB domain binding
definition: Binding to a phosphotyrosine-binding (PTB) Binding to a phosphotyrosine-bindin domain.

name: dol-P-Man:Man(5)GlcNAc(2)-PP-Dol alpha-1,3-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alpha-D-Man-(1->2)-alpha-D-Man-(1->2)-alpha-D-Man-(1->3)-[alpha-D-Man-(1->6)]-beta-D-Man-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc-diphospho-di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + a di-trans,poly-cis-dolichyl beta-D-mannosyl phosphate = an alpha-D-Man-(1->2)-alpha-D-Man-(1->2)-alpha-D-Man-(1->3)-[alpha-D-Man-(1->3)-alpha-D-Man-(1->6)]-beta-D-Man-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc-diphospho-di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + a di-trans,poly-cis-dolichyl phosphate + H+.

name: oncostatin-M receptor binding
definition: Binding to an oncostatin-M receptor.

name: very-low-density lipoprotein particle binding
definition: Binding to a very-low-density lipoprotein particle, a triglyceride-rich lipoprotein particle that is typically composed of APOB100, APOE and APOCs and has a density of about 1.006 g/ml and a diameter of between 20-80 nm.

name: tRNA guanylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the posttranscriptional addition of a guanyl residue to the 5' end of a tRNA molecule; observed for His tRNAs.

name: sialate 9-O-acetylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N-acetyl-9-O-acetylneuraminate = acetate + H+ + N-acetylneuraminate.

name: type I transforming growth factor beta receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type I transforming growth factor beta receptor.

name: propionyl-CoA carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + propanoyl-CoA + HCO3- = ADP + phosphate + (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA.

name: alpha-N-acetylneuraminate alpha-2,8-sialyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CMP-N-acetylneuraminate + alpha-N-acetylneuraminyl-(2->3)-beta-D-galactosyl-R = CMP + alpha-N-acetylneuraminyl-(2->8)-alpha-N-acetylneuraminyl-(2->3)-beta-D-galactosyl-R.

name: small protein activating enzyme binding
definition: Binding to a small protein activating enzyme, such as ubiquitin-activating enzyme.

name: tumor necrosis factor receptor binding
definition: Binding to a tumor necrosis factor receptor.

name: betaine-aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: betaine aldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = betaine + NADH + H+.

name: translation activator activity
definition: Any of a group of soluble proteins functioning in the activation of ribosome-mediated translation of mRNA into a polypeptide.

name: heparan sulfate binding
definition: Binding to heparan sulfate.

name: urea carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + bicarbonate + urea = ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate + urea-1-carboxylate.

name: 4-hydroxy-2-oxovalerate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxy-2-oxopentanoate = acetaldehyde + pyruvate.

name: structural constituent of myelin sheath
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of the myelin sheath of a nerve.

name: G protein-coupled bile acid receptor activity
definition: Combining with an extracellular bile acid and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

name: ethylene receptor activity
definition: Combining with ethylene and transmitting the signal in the cell to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: cyanide hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: formamide = H2O + hydrogen cyanide.

name: ABC-type sulfate transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + sulfate(out) = ADP + phosphate + sulfate(in).

name: UDP-glucuronate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-glucuronate + NAD+ = UDP-beta-L-threo-pentopyranos-4-ulose + CO2 + NADH.

name: muscle alpha-actinin binding
definition: Binding to muscle isoforms of actinin. Muscle alpha-actinin isoforms are found in skeletal and cardiac muscle and are localized to the Z-disc.

name: protein xylosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a beta-D-xylosyl residue from UDP-D-xylose to the serine hydroxyl group of an acceptor protein substrate.

name: protein-lysine 6-oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl-[protein] + O2 + H2O = (S)-2-amino-6-oxohexanoyl-[protein] + H2O2 + NH4+.

name: cholesterol-protein transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholesterol + glycyl-L-cysteinyl-[protein] + H+ = [protein]-C-terminal glycyl cholesterol ester + N-terminal L-cysteinyl-[protein].

name: RNA polymerase I cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding
definition: Binding to a specific upstream regulatory DNA sequence (transcription factor recognition sequence or binding site) located in cis relative to the transcription start site (i.e., on the same strand of DNA) of a gene transcribed by RNA polymerase I. RNA polymerase I elements are referred to either enhancers or upstream control element (UCE, or alternately referred to as the upstream element).

name: glutathione specific gamma-glutamylcyclotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glutathione = 5-oxoproline + L-cysteinylglycine.

name: ribose 1,5-bisphosphate phosphokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribose 1,5-diphosphate + ATP = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + ADP + H+.

name: blue light photoreceptor activity
definition: The function of absorbing and responding to electromagnetic radiation with a wavelength of approximately 400-470nm. The response may involve a change in conformation.

name: phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate 3-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate + H2O = phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate + phosphate.

name: trimethylamine monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N,N,N-trimethylamine + NADPH + H+ + O2 = N,N,N-trimethylamine N-oxide + NADP+ + H2O.

name: cytidine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of cytidine, cytosine riboside, from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: LPPG:FO 2-phospho-L-lactate transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7,8-didemethyl-8-hydroxy-5-deazariboflavin + lactyl-2-diphospho-5'-guanosine = coenzyme F420-0 + GMP.

name: phospho-N-acetylmuramoyl-pentapeptide-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl phosphate + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine = Mur2Ac(oyl-L-Ala-gamma-D-Glu-L-Lys-D-Ala-D-Ala)-di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + UMP.

name: [protein-PII] uridylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UTP + (protein-PII) = diphosphate + uridylyl-(protein-PII).

name: 3-hydroxypropionate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxypropanoate + NADP+ = 3-oxopropanoate + H+ + NADPH.

name: GDP-mannose 4,6-dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-alpha-D-mannose = GDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-alpha-D-mannose + H2O.

name: ceramide floppase activity
definition: Catalysis of the movement of ceramide from the cytosolic to the exoplasmic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP.

name: uridine phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine + phosphate = uracil + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.

name: tryptophan-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-tryptophan + tRNA(Trp) = AMP + diphosphate + L-tryptophanyl-tRNA(Trp).

name: tRNA (uracil(54)-C5)-methyltransferase activity, 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate-dependent
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine54 in tRNA + (6R)-5,10-methylene-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + NAD(P)H + H+ = 5-methyluridine54 in tRNA + (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + NAD(P)+.

name: BAT3 complex binding
definition: Binding to a BAT3 complex.

name: mannitol-1-phosphate 5-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannitol 1-phosphate + NAD+ = D-fructose 6-phosphate + NADH + H+.

name: alpha-1,4-glucan glucosyltransferase (UDP-glucose donor) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [(1->4)-alpha-D-glucosyl](n) + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = [(1->4)-alpha-D-glucosyl](n+1) + H+ + UDP.

name: ATP phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)-ATP + diphosphate = ATP + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate.

name: spermine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosylmethioninamine + spermidine = 5'-methylthioadenosine + spermine.

name: ABC-type glycerol-3-phosphate transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + glycerol-3-phosphate(out) = ADP + phosphate + glycerol-3-phosphate(in).

name: chondroitin sulfate binding
definition: Binding to chondroitin sulfate, a glycosaminoglycan made up of two alternating monosaccharides: D-glucuronic acid (GlcA) and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine (GalNAc).

name: S-methyl-5-thioribose kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-methyl-5-thio-D-ribose + ATP = S-methyl-5-thio-alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: glutaminyl-tRNA synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamine + glutamyl-tRNA(Gln) + ATP = L-glutamate + glutaminyl-tRNA(Gln) + phosphate + ADP.

name: box H/ACA snoRNA binding
definition: Binding to a box H/ACA small nucleolar RNA.

name: CCA tRNA nucleotidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a tRNA precursor + ATP + 2 CTP = a tRNA with a 3' CCA end + 3 diphosphate.

name: dCMP kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + dCMP = ADP + dCDP.

name: 1-deoxy-D-xylulose-5-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + H+ + pyruvate = 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate + CO2.

name: galactoside binding
definition: Binding to a glycoside in which the sugar group is galactose.

name: IgA binding
definition: Binding to an immunoglobulin of an IgA isotype.

name: inositol-3-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose 6-phosphate = 1D-myo-inositol 3-phosphate. This reaction requires NAD, which dehydrogenates the CHOH group to CO at C-5 of the glucose 6-phosphate, making C-6 into an active methylene, able to condense with the aldehyde at C-1. Finally, the enzyme-bound NADH reconverts C-5 into the CHOH form.

name: nitrate reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nitrite + NADP+ + H2O = nitrate + NADPH + H+.

name: glycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an acyl-CoA + sn-glycerol 3-phosphate = a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate + CoA.

name: peptidyl-cysteine S-nitrosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a nitric oxide (NO) group to a sulphur atom within a cysteine residue of a protein.

name: prenylcysteine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-prenyl-L-cysteine + O2 + H2O = a prenal + L-cysteine + H2O2.

name: nuclear import signal receptor activity
definition: Combining with a nuclear import signal (NIS) on a cargo to be transported, to mediate transport of the cargo through the nuclear pore, from the cytoplasm to the nuclear lumen. The cargo can be either a RNA or a protein.

name: L-histidinol-phosphate:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-histidinol-phosphate + 2-oxoglutarate = 3-(imidazol-4-yl)-2-oxopropyl phosphate + L-glutamate.

name: 11-cis-retinol dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 11-cis-retinol + NADP+ = 11-cis-retinal + NADPH + H+.

name: L-arginine N-succinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: succinyl-CoA + L-arginine = N2-succinyl-L-arginine + CoA + H+.

name: 1-acylglycerophosphocholine O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine + acyl-CoA = phosphatidylcholine + CoA.

name: 3-deoxy-manno-octulosonate cytidylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonate = diphosphate + CMP-3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonate.

name: malate dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-malate + NAD+ = pyruvate + CO2 + NADH.

name: 11-cis retinal binding
definition: Binding to 11-cis retinal, an isomer of retinal that plays an important role in the visual process in most vertebrates. 11-cis retinal combines with opsin in the rods (scotopsin) to form rhodopsin or visual purple. Retinal is one of the three compounds that makes up vitamin A.

name: nuclear androgen receptor binding
definition: Binding to a nuclear androgen receptor.

name: protein ADP-ribosyltransferase-substrate adaptor activity
definition: An enzyme-substrate adaptor that bings together a protein ADP-ribosyl transferase and its substrate.

name: cholesterol transfer activity
definition: Removes cholesterol from a membrane or a monolayer lipid particle, transports it through the aqueous phase while protected in a hydrophobic pocket, and brings it to an acceptor membrane or lipid particle.

name: chorismate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chorismate = 4-hydroxybenzoate + pyruvate.

name: malate:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: malate(out) + H+(out) = malate(in) + H+(in).

name: NAADP-sensitive calcium-release channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a calcium ion by a channel that opens when nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NAADP) has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: creatine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + creatine = N-phosphocreatine + ADP + 2 H+.

name: rRNA (adenine(2503)-C2-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine2503 in 23S rRNA + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2-methyladenosine2503 in 23S rRNA + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: riboflavin transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of riboflavin from one side of a membrane to the other. Riboflavin (vitamin B2) is a water-soluble B-complex vitamin, converted in the cell to FMN and FAD, cofactors required for the function of flavoproteins.

name: glucose sensor activity
definition: Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of glucose.

name: histone H3R26 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + (histone H3)-arginine (position 26) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + (histone H3)-N-methyl-arginine (position 26). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the arginine residue at position 26 of histone H3.

name: stretch-activated, monoatomic cation-selective, calcium channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a calcium ion by a channel that opens in response to a mechanical stress in the form of stretching.

name: quercetin 7-O-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a glucosyl group from UDP-glucose to the 7-hydroxy group of a quercetin molecule.

name: endo-1,3(4)-beta-glucanase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->3)- or (1->4)-linkages in beta-D-glucans when the glucose residue whose reducing group is involved in the linkage to be hydrolyzed is itself substituted at C-3. Substrates include laminarin, lichenin and cereal D-glucans.

name: all-trans-retinol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-retinol--[retinol-binding protein] + NAD+ = all-trans-retinal--[retinol-binding protein] + H+ + NADH. Recognizes the substrate both in free form and when bound to cellular-retinol-binding-protein (CRBP1), but has higher affinity for the bound form.

name: xanthine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of xanthine from one side of a membrane to the other. Xanthine (2,6-dihydroxypurine) is a purine formed in the metabolic breakdown of guanine, but is not present in nucleic acids.

name: fatty acid elongase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a very-long-chain acyl-CoA + H+ + malonyl-CoA = a very-long-chain 3-oxoacyl-CoA + CO2 + CoA. This reaction is the first (condensation) step of the four-step fatty acid elongation cycle in the endoplasmic reticulum that extends fatty acids of C-16 or longer with an additional 2-C unit.

name: cAMP-dependent protein kinase regulator activity
definition: Modulation of the activity of the enzyme cAMP-dependent protein kinase.

name: diamine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alpha,omega-diamine + 2-oxoglutarate = an omega-aminoaldehyde + L-glutamate.

name: glutathione gamma-glutamate hydrolase
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glutathione + H2O = L-cysteinylglycine + L-glutamate.

name: RNA 7-methylguanosine cap binding
definition: Binding to a 7-methylguanosine group added cotranscriptionally to the 5' end of RNA molecules transcribed by polymerase II.

name: ABC-type ferric iron transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Fe3+(out) = ADP + phosphate + Fe3+(in).

name: pyroglutamyl-peptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the release of the N-terminal pyroglutamyl group from a peptide or protein.

name: cis-stilbene-oxide hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-stilbene oxide + H2O = (+)-(1R,2R)-1,2-diphenylethane-1,2-diol.

name: cytokinin riboside 5'-monophosphate phosphoribohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-(dimethylallyl)adenosine 5'-phosphate + H2O = N(6)-dimethylallyladenine + D-ribose 5-phosphate.

name: RNA polymerase III type 2 promoter sequence-specific DNA binding
definition: Binding to a sequence of DNA that is a part of a type 2 promoter that controls transcription by RNA polymerase III. Type 2 promoters consist of an A box and a B box downstream of the transcription start site within the sequence within the sequence of the mature RNA. Type 2 promoters are found in many tRNA genes as well as in other small RNAs.

name: ammonia ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the ligation of ammonia (NH4+) to another substance via a carbon-nitrogen bond with concomitant breakage of a diphosphate linkage, usually in a nucleoside triphosphate.

name: glycogen binding
definition: Binding to glycogen.

name: galactosylgalactosylxylosylprotein 3-beta-glucuronosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-O-(beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1->4)-beta-D-xylosyl)-L-seryl-[protein] + UDP-alpha-D-glucuronate = 3-O-(beta-D-GlcA-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-beta-D-Xyl)-L-seryl-[protein] + H+ + UDP.

name: ribonuclease P activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA, removing 5' extra nucleotides from tRNA precursor.

name: alpha-aminoacyl-tRNA binding
definition: Binding to an alpha-aminoacyl-tRNA.

name: 1-phosphatidylinositol binding
definition: Binding to a phosphatidylinositol, a glycophospholipid with its sn-glycerol 3-phosphate residue is esterified to the 1-hydroxyl group of 1D-myo-inositol.

name: glycoprotein 6-alpha-L-fucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(4)-{N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->2)-alpha-D-mannosyl-(1->3)-[N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->2)-alpha-D-mannosyl-(1->6)]-beta-D-mannosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl}-L-asparagine + GDP-L-fucose = N(4)-{N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->2)-alpha-D-mannosyl-(1->3)-[N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->2)-alpha-D-mannosyl-(1->6)]-beta-D-mannosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->4)-[alpha-L-fucosyl-(1->6)]-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl}asparagine + GDP + H+.

name: amylo-alpha-1,6-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic branch linkages in glycogen phosphorylase limit dextrin. Limit dextrin is the highly branched core that remains after exhaustive treatment of glycogen with glycogen phosphorylase. It is formed because these enzymes cannot hydrolyze the (1->6) glycosidic linkages present.

name: NADPH dehydrogenase (quinone) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADPH + H+ + a quinone = NADP+ + a quinol.

name: methylmalonate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (acylating, NAD) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-methyl-3-oxopropanoate + CoA + NAD+ = propanoyl-CoA + hydrogencarbonate + NADH + H+. Can also use malonate (3-oxopropanoate) as a substrate. The reaction occurs in two steps with the decarboxylation process preceding CoA-binding. Bicarbonate rather than CO2 is released as a final product.

name: cholesterol binding
definition: Binding to cholesterol (cholest-5-en-3-beta-ol); the principal sterol of vertebrates and the precursor of many steroids, including bile acids and steroid hormones.

name: L-carnitine CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: (E)-4-(trimethylammonio)but-2-enoyl-CoA + L-carnitine = (E)-4-(trimethylammonio)but-2-enoate + L-carnitinyl-CoA and 4-trimethylammoniobutanoyl-CoA + L-carnitine = 4-trimethylammoniobutanoate + L-carnitinyl-CoA.

name: pyruvate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-oxo acid = an aldehyde + CO2.

name: MHC class II protein binding, via antigen binding groove
definition: Binding to the antigen binding groove of major histocompatibility complex class II molecules.

name: urocanate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-imidazolone-5-propanoate + H+ = trans-urocanate + H2O.

name: nitrate reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nitrite + NAD+ + H2O = nitrate + NADH + H+.

name: protein tyrosine phosphatase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a phosphotyrosine phosphatase, an enzyme which catalyzes of the removal of a phosphate group from a tyrosyl phenolic group of a protein.

name: HLH domain binding
definition: Binding to a Helix Loop Helix domain, a domain of 40-50 residues that occurs in specific DNA-binding proteins that act as transcription factors. The domain is formed of two amphipathic helices joined by a variable length linker region that can form a loop and it mediates protein dimerization.

name: proline-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-proline + tRNA(Pro) = AMP + diphosphate + L-prolyl-tRNA(Pro).

name: AMP-activated protein kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction requires the presence of AMP.

name: CCR5 chemokine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a CCR5 chemokine receptor.

name: tRNA (cytidine-N3)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a cytidine in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = an N3-methylcytidine in tRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: N-acylsphingosine amidohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-acylsphing-4-enine + H2O = a fatty acid + sphing-4-enine.

name: S-methyl-5-thioadenosine phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5'-methylthioadenosine + phosphate = adenine + 5-methylthio-D-ribose 1-phosphate.

name: cobyrinic acid a,c-diamide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the conversion of cobyrinic acid to cobyrinic acid a,c-diamide via the intermediate formation of cobyrinic acid c-monoamide.

name: peptide-methionine (R)-S-oxide reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-methionyl-[protein] + [thioredoxin]-disulfide + H2O = L-methionyl-(R)-S-oxide-[protein] + [thioredoxin]-dithiol.

name: long-chain-alcohol O-fatty-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain-alcohol + acyl-CoA = a long-chain ester + CoA.

name: retinol O-fatty-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + retinol = CoA + retinyl ester.

name: oxidoreductase activity, acting on iron-sulfur proteins as donors, dinitrogen as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which an iron-sulfur protein acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces dinitrogen.

name: structural constituent of chitin-based larval cuticle
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of the chitin-based cuticle of a larva. An example of this is found in Drosophila melanogaster.

name: neurotrophin TRKA receptor binding
definition: Binding to a neurotrophin TRKA receptor.

name: nucleoside:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: nucleoside(out) + Na+(out) = nucleoside(in) + Na+(in).

name: cysteine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-cysteine + tRNA(Cys) = AMP + diphosphate + L-cysteinyl-tRNA(Cys).

name: small conductance calcium-activated potassium channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of potassium by a channel with a unit conductance of 2 to 20 picoSiemens that opens in response to stimulus by internal calcium ions. Small conductance calcium-activated potassium channels are more sensitive to calcium than are large conductance calcium-activated potassium channels. Transport by a channel involves catalysis of facilitated diffusion of a solute (by an energy-independent process) involving passage through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel, without evidence for a carrier-mediated mechanism.

name: phosphorelay sensor kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the phosphorylation of a histidine residue in response to detection of an extracellular signal such as a chemical ligand or change in environment, to initiate a change in cell state or activity. The two-component sensor is a histidine kinase that autophosphorylates a histidine residue in its active site. The phosphate is then transferred to an aspartate residue in a downstream response regulator, to trigger a response.

name: UDP-N-acetylmuramoylalanine-D-glutamate ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glutamate + ATP + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanine = ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate.

name: galactoside 2-alpha-L-fucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-L-fucose + beta-D-galactosyl-R = GDP + alpha-L-fucosyl-(1,2)-beta-D-galactosyl-R.

name: demethylmenaquinone methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-demethylmenaquinol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a menaquinol + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. Reaction substrates can have varying polyprenyl side chain length.

name: extracellularly ATP-gated monoatomic cation channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a monoatomic cation by a channel that opens when ATP is bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts on the extracellular side of the plasma membrane.

name: acyl-[acyl-carrier-protein]-UDP-N-acetylglucosamine O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a (3R)-hydroxyacyl-[ACP] + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine = a UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + holo-[ACP].

name: proteinase activated receptor binding
definition: Binding to a proteinase activated receptor.

name: glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: NADP+ + sn-glycerol 3-phosphate = dihydroxyacetone phosphate + H+ + NADPH.

name: laminin receptor activity
definition: Combining with a laminin, a glycoprotein that constitutes the majority of proteins in the basement membrane, to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: formate-tetrahydrofolate ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + formate + tetrahydrofolate = ADP + phosphate + 10-formyltetrahydrofolate.

name: pinoresinol reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pinoresinol + NADPH + H+ = lariciresinol + NADP+.

name: 23S rRNA (adenine(1618)-N(6))-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + adenine(1618) in 23S rRNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + rRNA containing N(6)-methyladenine(1618) in 23S rRNA.

name: mannitol transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of mannitol from one side of a membrane to the other. Mannitol is the alditol derived from D-mannose by reduction of the aldehyde group.

name: 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate 5-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 3-phosphate + ATP = a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 3,5-bisphosphate + ADP + H+.

name: phosphoribosyl-AMP cyclohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(5-phosphonatoribosyl)-5'-AMP + H2O = 1-(5-phosphoribosyl)-5-[(5-phosphoribosylamino)methylideneamino]imidazole-4-carboxamide.

name: MDM2/MDM4 family protein binding
definition: Binding to a member of the MDM2/MDM4 protein family, comprising negative regulators of p53.

name: phosphate:acyl-[acyl carrier protein] acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a fatty acyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + orthophosphate = acyl phosphate + [acyl-carrier protein].

name: somatostatin receptor activity
definition: Combining with somatostatin to initiate a change in cell activity. Somatostatin is a peptide hormone that regulates the endocrine system by signaling via G protein-coupled somatostatin receptors. Somatostatin has two active forms produced by proteolytic cleavage: a 14 amino acid peptide (SST-14) and a 28 amino acid peptide (SST-28).

name: 18S rRNA (adenine(1779)-N(6)/adenine(1780)-N(6))-dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 S-adenosyl-L-methionine + adenine(1779)/adenine(1780) in 18S rRNA = 4 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + N(6)-dimethyladenine(1779)/N(6)-dimethyladenine(1780) in 18S rRNA.

name: FMN reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: FMNH2 + NADP+ = FMN + NADPH + 2 H+.

name: glucan 1,4-alpha-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal (1->4)-linked alpha-D-glucose residues successively from non-reducing ends of the chains with release of beta-D-glucose.

name: ATP:ADP antiporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP(out) + ADP(in) = ATP(in) + ADP(out).

name: protein phosphatase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a protein phosphatase.

name: water transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of water (H2O) from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: urease activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: urea + 2 H2O + H+ = hydrogencarbonate + 2 NH4+.

name: phosphomannomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-mannose 1-phosphate = D-mannose 6-phosphate.

name: ErbB-3 class receptor binding
definition: Binding to the protein-tyrosine kinase receptor ErbB-3/HER3.

name: MAP kinase kinase kinase kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the phosphorylation of serine and threonine residues in a mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase (MAPKKK), resulting in activation of MAPKKK. MAPKKK signaling pathways relay, amplify and integrate signals from the plasma membrane to the nucleus in response to a diverse range of extracellular stimuli.

name: cytochrome-b5 reductase activity, acting on NADH
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + NADH = 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + NAD+ + H+.

name: nitric oxide dioxygenase NAD(P)H activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 NO + 2 O2 + NAD(P)H + H+ = 2 nitrate + NAD(P)+.

name: Ser(Gly)-tRNA(Ala) hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of misacylated Ser-tRNA(Ala) and Gly-tRNA(Ala).

name: UMP kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + UMP = ADP + UDP.

name: pyridoxal binding
definition: Binding to pyridoxal, 3-hydroxy-5-(hydroxymethyl)-2-methylpyridine-4-carbaldehyde, a form of vitamin B6.

name: trans-cinnamate 4-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-cinnamate + NADPH + H+ + O2 = 4-hydroxycinnamate + NADP+ + H2O.

name: 5-oxoprolinase (ATP-hydrolyzing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-oxo-L-proline + ATP + 2 H2O = L-glutamate + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: insulin-like growth factor binding
definition: Binding to an insulin-like growth factor, any member of a group of polypeptides that are structurally homologous to insulin and share many of its biological activities, but are immunologically distinct from it.

name: histidine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-histidine + tRNA(His) = AMP + diphosphate + L-histidyl-tRNA(His).

name: intracellularly cGMP-activated cation channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a cation by a channel that opens when intracellular cGMP has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: deoxyuridine phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-deoxyuridine + phosphate = 2-deoxy-alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate + uracil.

name: type II transforming growth factor beta receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type II transforming growth factor beta receptor.

name: triose-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate = dihydroxyacetone phosphate.

name: GABA-A receptor activity
definition: Combining with the amino acid gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA, 4-aminobutyrate) to initiate a change in cell activity. GABA-A receptors function as chloride channels.

name: growth hormone receptor binding
definition: Binding to a growth hormone receptor.

name: malonate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (acetylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-oxopropanoate + CoA + NAD(P)+ = acetyl-CoA + CO2 + NAD(P)H.

name: acetylglutamate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + N-acetyl-L-glutamate = ADP + N-acetyl-L-glutamate-5-phosphate.

name: D-sedoheptulose 7-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-sedoheptulose-7-phosphate = D-alpha,beta-D-heptose 7-phosphate.

name: phosphopyruvate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-phospho-D-glycerate = phosphoenolpyruvate + H2O.

name: deoxyribose-phosphate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-deoxy-D-ribose 5-phosphate = D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + acetaldehyde.

name: Arp2/3 complex binding
definition: Binding to an Arp2/3 complex, a protein complex that contains two actin-related proteins, Arp2 and Arp3, and five novel proteins (ARPC1-5).

name: glucose-1-phosphate adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate + ATP = ADP-glucose + diphosphate.

name: ubiquitin-ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Isoenergetic transfer of ubiquitin from one protein to an existing ubiquitin chain via the reaction X-ubiquitin + Y-ubiquitin = Y-ubiquitin-ubiquitin + X, where both the X-ubiquitin and Y-ubiquitin-ubiquitin linkages are thioester bonds between the C-terminal glycine of ubiquitin and a sulfhydryl side group of a cysteine residue.

name: auxin efflux transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of auxin, from one side of a membrane to the other, out of a cell.

name: beta-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues in N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminides.

name: D-ribose pyranase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: beta-D-ribopyranose = beta-D-ribofuranose, and beta-allofuranose = beta-allopyranose.

name: N6-methyladenosine-containing RNA reader activity
definition: A protein adaptor that recognizes and binds an RNA molecule modified by N6-methyladenosine (m6A), a modification present at internal sites of mRNAs and some non-coding RNAs.

name: endo-alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions : D-galactosyl-3-(N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosaminyl)-L-serine + H2O = D-galactosyl-3-N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosamine + L-serine and D-galactosyl-3-(N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosaminyl)-L-threonyl + H2O = D-galactosyl-3-N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosamine + L-threonyl.

name: spermidine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of spermidine, N-(3-aminopropyl)-1,4-diaminobutane, from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: thyroid hormone binding
definition: Binding to thyroxine (T4) or triiodothyronine (T3), tyrosine-based hormones produced by the thyroid gland.

name: cyclic-GMP-AMP transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of cyclic-GMP-AMP from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: NADPH-hemoprotein reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADPH + H+ + n oxidized hemoprotein = NADP+ + n reduced hemoprotein.

name: glucuronate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucuronate = D-fructuronate. Also converts D-galacturonate to D-tagaturonate.

name: adenylate cyclase binding
definition: Binding to an adenylate cyclase.

name: superoxide-generating NAD(P)H oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD(P)H + O2 = NAD(P)H + O2-.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (ATP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + oxaloacetate = ADP + CO2 + H+ + phosphoenolpyruvate.

name: cyclin-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: Cyclin-dependent catalysis of the phosphorylation of an amino acid residue in a protein, usually according to the reaction: a protein + ATP = a phosphoprotein + ADP.

name: protein-L-histidine N-tele-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-histidyl-[protein] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(tele)-methyl-L-histidyl-[protein] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: ubiquitin ligase complex scaffold activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together an ubiquitin ligase and an ubiquitin ligase-substrate adaptor, permitting those molecules to function in a coordinated way.

name: glycylpeptide N-tetradecanoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tetradecanoyl-CoA + glycyl-peptide = CoA + N-tetradecanoylglycyl-peptide.

name: selenocysteine lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-selenocysteine + reduced acceptor = hydrogen selenide + L-alanine + acceptor.

name: tagaturonate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-altronate + NAD+ = D-tagaturonate + H+ + NADH.

name: ubiquitin activating enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: E1 + ubiquitin + ATP--> E1-ubiquitin + AMP + PPi, where the E1-ubiquitin linkage is a thioester bond between the C-terminal glycine of Ub and a sulfhydryl side group of an E1 cysteine residue. This is the first step in a cascade of reactions in which ubiquitin is ultimately added to a protein substrate.

name: tRNA (5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridylate)(34)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-aminomethyl-2-thiouridine34 in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridine34 in tRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This enzyme specifically adds the terminal methyl group of 5-[(methylamino)methyl]-2-thiouridylate.

name: insulin receptor substrate binding
definition: Binding to an insulin receptor substrate (IRS) protein, an adaptor protein that bind to the transphosphorylated insulin and insulin-like growth factor receptors, are themselves phosphorylated and in turn recruit SH2 domain-containing signaling molecules to form a productive signaling complex.

name: insulin-like growth factor II binding
definition: Binding to insulin-like growth factor II.

name: uridine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of uridine, uracil riboside, from one side of a membrane to the other.

name: superoxide-generating NADPH oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADPH + 2 O2 = H+ + NADP+ + 2 superoxide.

name: sterol 14-demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 14alpha-methyl steroid + 3 O2 + 3 reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = a delta14 steroid + formate + 4 H+ + 4 H2O + 3 oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase].

name: cAMP-dependent protein kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a cAMP-dependent protein kinase.

name: ATP-dependent peptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds, driven by ATP hydrolysis.

name: asparagine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-asparagine + ATP + tRNA(Asn) = AMP + Asn-tRNA(Asn) + diphosphate + 2 H+.

name: L-glutamate N-acetyltransferase activity, acting on acetyl-CoA as donor
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-L-glutamate + CoA + H+.

name: transmembrane-ephrin receptor activity
definition: Combining with a transmembrane ephrin to initiate a change in cell activity.

name: alkanesulfonate monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alkanesulfonate + O2 + FMNH2 = an aldehyde + sulfite + H2O + FMN.

name: tripeptidyl-peptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the release of an N-terminal tripeptide from a polypeptide.

name: beta-ketoacyl-acyl-carrier-protein synthase III activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + malonyl-[acyl-carrier protein] = acetoacyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + CoA + CO2.

name: cytokine activity
definition: The activity of a soluble extracellular gene product that interacts with a receptor to effect a change in the activity of the receptor to control the survival, growth, differentiation and effector function of tissues and cells.

name: AP-1 adaptor complex binding
definition: Binding to an AP-1 adaptor complex. The AP-1 adaptor complex is a heterotetrameric AP-type membrane coat adaptor complex that consists of beta1, gamma, mu1 and sigma1 subunits and links clathrin to the membrane surface of a vesicle. In at least humans, the AP-1 complex can be heterogeneric due to the existence of multiple subunit isoforms encoded by different genes (gamma1 and gamma2, mu1A and mu1B, and sigma1A, sigma1B and sigma1C).

name: dephospho-CoA kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-dephospho-CoA + ATP = ADP + CoA + 2 H+.

name: [protein]-3-O-(N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl)-L-serine/L-threonine O-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-O-(N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl)-L-seryl/L-threonyl-[protein] + H2O = L-seryl//L-threonyl-[protein] + N-acetyl-D-glucosamine.

name: serine O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a fatty acyl-CoA + L-seryl-[protein] = CoA + O-fatty acyl-L-seryl-[protein].

name: interleukin-5 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-5 receptor.

name: stem cell factor receptor binding
definition: Binding to a stem cell factor receptor (SCFR), a type III transmembrane kinase receptor.

name: arginine binding
definition: Binding to 2-amino-5-(carbamimidamido)pentanoic acid.

name: thymidylate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + dUMP = 7,8-dihydrofolate + thymidylate.

name: phosphogluconate dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-phospho-D-gluconate + NADP+ = D-ribulose 5-phosphate + CO2 + NADPH + H+.

name: aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + NADP+ + phosphate = 4-phospho-L-aspartate + H+ + NADPH.

name: carbonyl reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a secondary alcohol + NADP+ = a ketone + H+ + NADPH.

name: intracellularly calcium-gated channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a solute by a channel that opens when calcium ions bind on the intracellular side of the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

name: nuclear estrogen receptor activity
definition: A nuclear receptor activity regulated by estrogen binding and modulating the transcription of specific gene sets transcribed by RNA polymerase II.

name: GPI anchor binding
definition: Binding to a glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchor. GPI anchors serve to attach membrane proteins to the lipid bilayer of cell membranes.

name: intracellularly calcium-gated chloride channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of chloride by a channel that opens in response to stimulus by a calcium ion or ions. Transport by a channel involves catalysis of facilitated diffusion of a solute (by an energy-independent process) involving passage through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel, without evidence for a carrier-mediated mechanism.

name: C-palmitoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a palmitoyl group to a carbon atom on the acceptor molecule.

name: serine C-palmitoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + H+ + palmitoyl-CoA = 3-dehydrosphinganine + CO2 + CoA.

name: UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate-L-lysine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysine + ATP + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate = ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-L-lysine.

name: phosphoribosylglycinamide formyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 10-formyltetrahydrofolate + N1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)glycinamide = tetrahydrofolate + N2-formyl-N1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)glycinamide.

name: protein O-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + [protein]-L-serine = UDP + [protein]-3-O-(N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl)-L-serine, or UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + [protein]-L-threonine = UDP + [protein]-3-O-(N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl)-L-threonine.

name: bacteriochlorophyll binding
definition: Binding to bacteriochlorophyll, a form of chlorophyll found in photosynthetic bacteria, such as the purple and green bacteria. There are several types, designated a to g. Bacteriochlorophyll a and bacteriochlorophyll b are structurally similar to the chlorophyll a and chlorophyll b found in plants.

name: aspartate carbamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate + carbamoyl phosphate = N-carbamoyl-L-aspartate + H+ + phosphate.

name: 3-phosphoshikimate 1-carboxyvinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phosphoshikimate + phosphoenolpyruvate = 5-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-3-phosphoshikimate + phosphate.

name: asparaginase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-asparagine + H2O = L-aspartate + NH4+.

name: methionine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-methionine + tRNA(Met) = AMP + diphosphate + L-methionyl-tRNA(Met).

name: glutamine synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-glutamate + NH4+ = ADP + H+ + L-glutamine + phosphate.

name: dolichyl-phosphate-mannose-protein mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dolichyl phosphate D-mannose + protein = dolichyl phosphate + O-D-mannosylprotein.

name: nicotianamine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) = 3 S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine + 3 H+ + nicotianamine.

name: insulin-like growth factor receptor binding
definition: Binding to an insulin-like growth factor receptor.

name: ATP-dependent diacylglycerol kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol + ATP = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate + ADP + H+.

name: phosphatidate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacylglycerol 3-phosphate + H2O = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol + phosphate.

name: L-alanine:glyoxylate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-alanine + glyoxylate = pyruvate + glycine.

name: tRNA-uracil-4 sulfurtransferase activity
definition: Catalyzes the reaction: ATP + [ThiI sulfur-carrier protein]-S-sulfanyl-L-cysteine + uracil in tRNA + 2 reduced ferredoxin [iron-sulfur] cluster = AMP + diphosphate + 4-thiouracil in tRNA + [ThiI sulfur-carrier protein]-L-cysteine + 2 oxidized ferredoxin [iron-sulfur] cluster.

name: RNA polymerase I core binding
definition: Binding to a RNA polymerase I core enzyme, a multisubunit eukaryotic nuclear RNA polymerase typically composed of seventeen subunits.

name: ABC-type glutathione S-conjugate transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an S-substituted glutathione(in) + ATP + H2O = an S-substituted glutathione(out) + ADP + phosphate + H+.

name: hydroxypyruvate reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-glycerate + NAD+ = 3-hydroxypyruvate + NADH + H+.

name: poly(A) RNA polymerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n)-3'-adenine ribonucleotide. The primer may be an RNA or DNA fragment, or oligo(A) bearing a 3'-OH terminal group.

name: nuclear thyroid hormone receptor binding
definition: Binding to a nuclear thyroid hormone receptor.

name: ceramide 1-phosphate transfer activity
definition: Removes a ceramide 1-phosphate from a membrane or a monolayer lipid particle, transports it through the aqueous phase while protected in a hydrophobic pocket, and brings it to an acceptor membrane or lipid particle.

name: GMP synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + XMP + L-glutamine + H2O = AMP + diphosphate + GMP + L-glutamate + 2H+.

name: nitrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 16 ATP + 16 H2O + N2 + 8 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] = 16 ADP + 6 H+ + H2 + 2 NH4+ + 8 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 16 phosphate.

name: calcium-dependent cysteine-type endopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of nonterminal peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism using a cysteine residue at the enzyme active center, and requiring the presence of calcium.

name: transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase adaptor activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase and one or more other molecules, permitting them to function in a coordinated way.

name: cargo adaptor activity
definition: Binding directly to the structural scaffolding elements of a vesicle coat (such as clathrin or COPII), and bridging the membrane, cargo receptor, and membrane deformation machinery.

name: 6,7-dimethyl-8-ribityllumazine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone-4-phosphate + 5-amino-6-ribitylamino-2,4(1H,3H)-pyrimidinedione = 6,7-dimethyl-8-ribityllumazine + phosphate.

name: guanylate cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GTP = 3',5'-cyclic GMP + diphosphate.

name: nuclear localization sequence binding
definition: Binding to a nuclear localization sequence, a specific peptide sequence that acts as a signal to localize the protein within the nucleus.

name: sucrose alpha-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sucrose + H2O = alpha-D-glucose + beta-D-fructose.

name: glycine hydroxymethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (6R)-5,10-methylene-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + glycine + H2O = (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + L-serine.

name: quinone reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 a quinone + NADPH + H+ = 2 a 1,4-benzosemiquinone + NADP+.

name: phosphatidylethanolamine binding
definition: Binding to a phosphatidylethanolamine, a class of glycerophospholipids in which a phosphatidyl group is esterified to the hydroxyl group of ethanolamine.

name: protein-glutamine gamma-glutamyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutaminyl-[protein] + L-lysyl-[protein] = [protein]-L-lysyl-N(6)-5-L-glutamyl-[protein] + NH4+. This reaction is the formation of the N6-(L-isoglutamyl)-L-lysine isopeptide, resulting in cross-linking polypeptide chains; the gamma-carboxamide groups of peptidyl-glutamine residues act as acyl donors, and the 6-amino-groups of peptidyl-lysine residues act as acceptors, to give intra- and intermolecular N6-(5-glutamyl)lysine cross-links.

name: prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoate + AH2 + 2 O2 = A + H2O + prostaglandin H2.

name: extracellular matrix structural constituent conferring tensile strength
definition: A constituent of the extracellular matrix that enables the matrix to resist longitudinal stress.

name: selenide, water dikinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + hydrogen selenide = AMP + 3 H+ + phosphate + selenophosphorate.

name: thiazole synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate + 2-iminoacetate + [sulfur-carrier protein ThiS]-C-terminal Gly-NH-CH2-C(O)SH = 2-[(2R,5Z)-2-carboxy-4-methylthiazol-5(2H)-ylidene]ethyl phosphate + [sulfur-carrier protein ThiS]-C-terminal Gly-Gly + 2 H+ + 2 H2O.

name: 3-chloroallyl aldehyde dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-chloroallyl aldehyde + H2O = 2 H+ + 2 e- + 3-chloroacrylic acid.

name: ubiquitin conjugating enzyme activity
definition: Isoenergetic transfer of ubiquitin from one protein to another via the reaction X-ubiquitin + Y = Y-ubiquitin + X, where both the X-ubiquitin and Y-ubiquitin linkages are thioester bonds between the C-terminal glycine of ubiquitin and a sulfhydryl side group of a cysteine residue.

name: 3'-nucleotidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3'-ribonucleotide + H2O = a ribonucleoside + phosphate.

name: protein-arginine omega-N symmetric methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the addition of a second methyl group to methylated peptidyl-arginine. Methylation is on the terminal nitrogen (omega nitrogen) residue that is not already methylated, resulting in symmetrical peptidyl-N(omega),N'(omega)-dimethyled arginine residues.

name: I-SMAD binding
definition: Binding to an inhibitory SMAD signaling protein.

name: glucosamine 6-phosphate N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + CoA + H+.

name: acetate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + acetate = ADP + acetyl phosphate.

name: nuclear vitamin D receptor binding
definition: Binding to a nuclear vitamin D receptor, a nuclear receptor that mediates the action of vitamin D by binding DNA and controlling the transcription of hormone-sensitive genes.

name: glycine N-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + glycine = CoA + N-acylglycine.

name: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-mannitol phosphotransferase system transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + mannitol(out) = protein histidine + mannitol phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

name: Wnt receptor activity
